ex.en: The exam must be answered in ink.
ex.zh: 考试必须用墨水笔作答。

tip: in ink 是“用钢笔写”；in pencil 用铅笔写。
scene: A hand writing with a blue pen on a form.

senses.en: at the correct time

ex.en: The train arrived on time.
ex.zh: 火车准点到达。

ex.en: Please be on time for the meeting.
ex.zh: 请准时参加会议。

tip: on time 是“准时”；in time 是“及时”。
scene: A station clock showing the exact time as a train arrives.

senses.en: to continue doing something

ex.en: Carry on with your work; I'll wait outside.
ex.zh: 继续你的工作，我在外面等。

ex.en: She carried on talking even after the bell rang.
ex.zh: 铃响后她还在继续说。

tip: carry on (with) 是“继续做某事”。
scene: A student continuing to write notes while others pack up.

senses.en: a place open at night for music and dancing

ex.en: The nightclub was very crowded on Friday.
ex.zh: 周五夜店非常拥挤。

ex.en: You must be over eighteen to enter the nightclub.
ex.zh: 年满十八岁才能进夜店。

tip: nightclub 是夜店；注意未成年人禁止进入。
scene: A neon-lit nightclub entrance with music signs at night.

senses.en: television

ex.en: We watched the match on TV.
ex.zh: 我们在电视上看了比赛。

ex.en: The TV is in the living room.
ex.zh: 电视在客厅里。

tip: TV 是 television 的缩写；watch TV 看电视。
scene: A family watching a match on TV in a living room.

senses.en: the state of having no job

ex.en: Unemployment in the town has risen this year.
ex.zh: 今年这个镇的失业率上升了。

ex.en: The government is trying to reduce unemployment.
ex.zh: 政府正努力降低失业率。

tip: unemployment 是“失业/失业率”；unemployed 是“失业的”。
scene: A job centre with people reading vacancy boards.

senses.en: certainly; used to agree

ex.en: 'Can you help me?' 'Of course!'
ex.zh: “你能帮我吗？”“当然！”

ex.en: Of course, I'll come to your party.
ex.zh: 我当然会来参加你的聚会。

tip: of course 表示“当然”，是肯定回答。
scene: A person nodding and smiling while saying of course.

senses.en: completely new

ex.en: He bought a brand new bicycle.
ex.zh: 他买了一辆全新的自行车。

ex.en: The brand new school opens next week.
ex.zh: 这所崭新的学校下周开学。

tip: brand new 强调“崭新”，比 new 语气更强。
scene: A shiny new bicycle with a price tag still on it.

senses.en: to stop a fire or light burning

ex.en: The firemen put out the fire quickly.
ex.zh: 消防员很快扑灭了大火。

ex.en: Please put out the candle before you sleep.
ex.zh: 睡前请吹灭蜡烛。

tip: put out 表示“扑灭（火）、熄灭（灯）”。
scene: A firefighter spraying water to put out a small fire.

senses.en: to finally be in a situation or place

ex.en: We got lost and ended up at the beach.
ex.zh: 我们迷路了，最后到了海滩。

ex.en: He studied hard and ended up with a good job.
ex.zh: 他努力学习，最后得到了一份好工作。

tip: end up 表示“最终落得/到达某状态”，后接介词短语或动名词。
scene: Two friends laughing as they arrive at a beach after getting lost.

senses.en: at one moment together; at once

ex.en: The two trains arrived at the station at the same time.
ex.zh: 两列火车同时到达车站。

ex.en: She can study and listen to music at the same time.
ex.zh: 她能同时学习和听音乐。

tip: at the same time 表示“同时发生”。
scene: Two trains pulling into a station at the same moment.

senses.en: to stop fighting and accept, or to hand in

ex.en: He refused to give in and kept trying.
ex.zh: 他拒绝放弃，继续尝试。

ex.en: Please give in your homework by Friday.
ex.zh: 请周五前交作业。

tip: give in 表示“屈服/让步”；英式也指“交作业”。
scene: A child finally agreeing and giving in after an argument.

senses.en: the time when you stop working because of age

ex.en: My grandfather enjoys gardening after retirement.
ex.zh: 爷爷退休后喜欢园艺。

ex.en: She is planning for her retirement.
ex.zh: 她正在规划退休生活。

tip: retirement 是“退休”；retired 是“退休的”。
scene: A retired man watering flowers in his garden.

senses.en: a very long time (informal)

ex.en: I haven't seen you for ages!
ex.zh: 我好久没见你了！

ex.en: It took ages to finish the homework.
ex.zh: 做完作业花了很久。

tip: for ages 是口语“很长时间”，用于夸张表达。
scene: Two friends meeting excitedly after a long time apart.

senses.en: into two pieces

ex.en: The rope broke in two.
ex.zh: 绳子断成两段。

ex.en: She tore the paper in two.
ex.zh: 她把纸撕成两半。

tip: break/tear in two 表示“断/撕成两半”。
scene: A torn sheet of paper split in two on a table.

senses.en: a person who travels with a backpack, usually cheaply

ex.en: Backpackers often stay in cheap hostels.
ex.zh: 背包客通常住便宜的青年旅舍。

ex.en: He met other backpackers on the train.
ex.zh: 他在火车上遇到了其他背包客。

tip: backpacker 是背包旅行的游客；backpacking 是背包旅行。
scene: A backpacker with a big backpack looking at a map at a train station.

senses.en: to ring, or to become bad (about food)

ex.en: My alarm clock went off at seven.
ex.zh: 我的闹钟七点响了。

ex.en: The milk has gone off; don't drink it.
ex.zh: 牛奶变质了，别喝。

tip: go off 指闹钟“响”或食物“变质”。
scene: A ringing alarm clock beside a bed in the morning.

senses.en: to start a journey

ex.en: We set off for the beach at eight in the morning.
ex.zh: 我们早上八点出发去海滩。

ex.en: They set off early to avoid the traffic.
ex.zh: 他们早出发以避开交通拥堵。

tip: set off 表示“出发”；set off for + 目的地。
scene: A family with bags setting off from home early in the morning.

senses.en: on vacation; taking a break from work

ex.en: The Smiths are on holiday in Spain this week.
ex.zh: 史密斯一家这周在西班牙度假。

ex.en: She is on holiday and will be back on Monday.
ex.zh: 她在度假，周一回来。

tip: on holiday 是英式“度假”；美式说 on vacation。
scene: A family with sunglasses relaxing on a sunny beach.

senses.en: a piece of jewellery worn on the ear

ex.en: She wears gold earrings to the party.
ex.zh: 她戴着金耳环去参加聚会。

ex.en: I lost one of my earrings.
ex.zh: 我丢了一只耳环。

tip: earring 复数 earrings；一对耳环说 a pair of earrings。
scene: A pair of gold earrings lying on a jewellery box on a dressing table.

senses.en: happening later than planned

ex.en: The train is delayed by twenty minutes.
ex.zh: 火车延误二十分钟。

ex.en: Our flight was delayed because of the weather.
ex.zh: 我们的航班因为天气延误了。

tip: delayed 常用于交通：航班/火车延误。注意：延迟的航班说 delayed flight。
scene: An airport screen showing a delayed flight next to a waiting passenger.

senses.en: used to say something is possible

ex.en: She might come to the party, but she's not sure.
ex.zh: 她可能会来参加聚会，但还不确定。

ex.en: It might snow tomorrow.
ex.zh: 明天可能会下雪。

tip: might 表示可能性，比 may 更不确定。
scene: A girl looking at a cloudy sky wondering if it might snow.

senses.en: to become husband and wife

ex.en: They are going to get married next spring.
ex.zh: 他们明年春天要结婚了。

ex.en: My cousin got married last weekend.
ex.zh: 我表哥上周末结婚了。

tip: get married 表示“结婚”的动作；be married 表示“已婚”状态。
scene: A happy couple in wedding clothes cutting a cake in a garden.

senses.en: to become an adult

ex.en: She grew up in a small town near the sea.
ex.zh: 她在海边的一个小镇长大。

ex.en: What do you want to be when you grow up?
ex.zh: 你长大后想做什么？

tip: grow up 表示“长大成人”；grown-up 是名词“成年人”。
scene: A photo album showing a baby growing into a smiling adult.

senses.en: eggs beaten and cooked flat in a pan

ex.en: She made a cheese omelette for breakfast.
ex.zh: 她做了奶酪煎蛋卷当早餐。

ex.en: I'd like an omelette with mushrooms, please.
ex.zh: 请给我一份蘑菇煎蛋卷。

tip: omelette 是摊开的煎蛋饼，可加奶酪、蔬菜等。
scene: A golden omelette with cheese on a plate on a breakfast table.

senses.en: the sport of riding waves on a surfboard

ex.en: Surfboarding is popular at the seaside.
ex.zh: 海边很流行冲浪。

ex.en: She practises surfboarding every summer.
ex.zh: 她每年夏天练习冲浪。

tip: surfboarding 与 surfing 都指冲浪运动。
scene: A surfer riding a big wave on a surfboard at the beach.

senses.en: to return to a place, or to get something again

ex.en: What time did you get back from school?
ex.zh: 你几点从学校回来的？

ex.en: I got my money back from the shop.
ex.zh: 我从商店拿回了钱。

tip: get back 可指“返回”或“收回”；get back home 回家。
scene: A girl walking back home through the front door carrying a school bag.

senses.en: a game where players hit a small ball over a net on a table

ex.en: We play table tennis in the school hall.
ex.zh: 我们在学校大厅里打乒乓球。

ex.en: Table tennis is a fast and exciting game.
ex.zh: 乒乓球是一项快速刺激的运动。

tip: table tennis 即乒乓球，也叫 ping-pong。
scene: Two players playing table tennis with paddles and a small white ball.

senses.en: a polite greeting used in the morning

ex.en: Good morning, class!
ex.zh: 同学们，早上好！

ex.en: She wished us good morning as we came in.
ex.zh: 我们进来时她向我们问早安。

tip: good morning 用于早晨的问候（到中午前）。
scene: A teacher greeting students with a smile at the classroom door in the morning.

senses.en: a friend you write letters to but may never meet

ex.en: I have a penfriend in Australia.
ex.zh: 我有一个澳大利亚的笔友。

ex.en: She wrote a letter to her penfriend in English.
ex.zh: 她用英语给笔友写了一封信。

tip: penfriend 是英式说法，pen pal 是美式说法。
scene: A girl writing a letter at a desk with a world map behind her.

senses.en: thin clothes covering the legs worn by women or children

ex.en: She wore red tights with her dress.
ex.zh: 她穿着红色连裤袜配连衣裙。

ex.en: A pair of tights is in the laundry basket.
ex.zh: 洗衣篮里有一条连裤袜。

col: a pair of tights｜一条连裤袜
tip: tights 常用复数；一条说 a pair of tights。
scene: A pair of red tights hanging over a chair in a bedroom.

senses.en: also; in addition

ex.en: She speaks French, and she speaks German as well.
ex.zh: 她会说法语，也会说德语。

ex.en: I'll have a coffee, and a cake as well, please.
ex.zh: 请给我一杯咖啡，再来一块蛋糕。

tip: as well 放在句末，too 常放句末，also 常放句中。
scene: A café table with a cup of coffee and a slice of chocolate cake.

senses.en: to move or travel somewhere

ex.en: We go to school by bike.
ex.zh: 我们骑自行车上学。

ex.en: Let's go to the park this afternoon.
ex.zh: 今天下午我们去公园吧。

tip: go 的过去式是 went，过去分词是 gone/been。
scene: Two children riding bikes along a road towards a school.

senses.en: a two-wheeled vehicle with an engine

ex.en: He rides his motorbike to work every day.
ex.zh: 他每天骑摩托车上班。

ex.en: The motorbike stopped in front of the café.
ex.zh: 摩托车停在咖啡馆前面。

tip: motorbike 是英式口语说法；motorcycle 更正式。
scene: A red motorbike parked on a street with a helmet on the seat.

senses.en: cooked in very hot water

ex.en: I like boiled eggs for breakfast.
ex.zh: 早餐我喜欢吃煮鸡蛋。

ex.en: She made boiled potatoes for dinner.
ex.zh: 她晚饭做了煮土豆。

tip: boiled 指用开水煮过的；fried 是煎的，roasted 是烤的。
scene: Two boiled eggs in an egg cup on a breakfast table with toast.

senses.en: used to say something is necessary

ex.en: I have to get up early tomorrow.
ex.zh: 我明天必须早起。

ex.en: Do we have to wear a uniform at school?
ex.zh: 我们在学校必须穿校服吗？

tip: have to 表客观需要，must 表主观必须；否定 don't have to 是“不必”。
scene: A student in a school uniform looking at an alarm clock.

senses.en: used to add something new to a conversation

ex.en: By the way, do you know the homework for today?
ex.zh: 顺便问一下，你知道今天的作业吗？

ex.en: Oh, by the way, I saw your brother yesterday.
ex.zh: 哦对了，我昨天看到你哥哥了。

tip: by the way 常用于口语，在交谈中引出新话题，可缩写为 BTW。
scene: Two students chatting at school, one suddenly remembering something.

senses.en: to write information in a form

ex.en: Please fill in this form with your name.
ex.zh: 请在这张表格上填上你的名字。

ex.en: She filled in the answers in pen.
ex.zh: 她用钢笔填写了答案。

tip: fill in 用于“填表”；fill out 也是美式常见说法。
scene: A hand writing on an application form at a desk.

senses.en: a small box or bag for pens and pencils

ex.en: My pencil case has two pens and three pencils.
ex.zh: 我的文具盒里有两支钢笔和三支铅笔。

ex.en: Don't forget your pencil case for the exam.
ex.zh: 考试别忘了带文具盒。

tip: pencil case 是装笔的文具盒/袋。
scene: An open pencil case with pens, pencils and an eraser on a desk.

senses.en: a page of information on the internet

ex.en: This web page has pictures of animals.
ex.zh: 这个网页有动物的图片。

ex.en: She found the information on a school web page.
ex.zh: 她在一个学校网页上找到了信息。

tip: web page 是网页；website 是网站（由多个网页组成）。
scene: A laptop screen showing a colourful web page about animals.

senses.en: belonging to a male person

ex.en: This is his bicycle.
ex.zh: 这是他的自行车。

ex.en: He left his jacket at school.
ex.zh: 他把夹克落在学校了。

tip: his 既是形容词性物主代词（his bike），也是名词性物主代词（it's his）。
scene: A boy getting on his bicycle parked against a wall.

senses.en: the person speaking, when someone does something to them

ex.en: Can you help me with my bag?
ex.zh: 你能帮我拿一下包吗？

ex.en: The teacher gave me a book.
ex.zh: 老师给了我一本书。

tip: me 是 I 的宾格，作动词/介词的宾语。
scene: A friend helping another carry a heavy school bag.

senses.en: a clock that makes a noise to wake you up

ex.en: My alarm clock rings at seven every morning.
ex.zh: 我的闹钟每天早上七点响。

ex.en: He set the alarm clock for six o'clock.
ex.zh: 他把闹钟定在六点。

tip: set the alarm clock 表示“定闹钟”，wake up 表示“醒来”。
scene: A ringing alarm clock on a bedside table in a bright bedroom at dawn.

senses.en: feeling unhappy

ex.en: She felt sad when her friend moved away.
ex.zh: 朋友搬走时她很难过。

ex.en: The sad film made everyone cry.
ex.zh: 这部悲伤的电影让大家都哭了。

tip: sad 形容悲伤；名词 sadness 悲伤，副词 sadly 悲伤地。
scene: A girl sitting alone on a bench looking down with a sad face.

senses.en: used in questions about people

ex.en: Who is that girl over there?
ex.zh: 那边那个女孩是谁？

ex.en: Who helped you with the homework?
ex.zh: 谁帮你做作业了？

tip: who 用于询问人；Whose 是询问“谁的”。
scene: A child pointing at a girl across the playground and asking who she is.

senses.en: a member of the police force

ex.en: The police officer helped the lost child.
ex.zh: 警察帮助了迷路的孩子。

ex.en: Ask a police officer if you need directions.
ex.zh: 需要问路可以找警察。

tip: police officer 是不分性别的说法；policeman 是男警。
scene: A police officer in uniform helping a lost child on a street.

senses.en: very close to something, beside it

ex.en: The bank is next to the supermarket.
ex.zh: 银行紧挨着超市。

ex.en: She sat next to me in the cinema.
ex.zh: 她在电影院里坐在我旁边。

tip: next to 表示“紧挨着”；near 是“附近”，距离更远。
scene: A bank building standing right beside a supermarket.

senses.en: to learn or discover something

ex.en: I called the cinema to find out the film times.
ex.zh: 我打电话给电影院查放映时间。

ex.en: She found out the answer in the book.
ex.zh: 她在书里找到了答案。

tip: find out 强调“经过打听/查询后得知”；find 更强调“找到”。
scene: A girl on the phone checking film times with a notepad.

senses.en: to stop working (about a machine or car)

ex.en: Our car broke down on the way to the beach.
ex.zh: 我们的车在去海滩的路上抛锚了。

ex.en: The washing machine has broken down again.
ex.zh: 洗衣机又坏了。

tip: break down 指机器、汽车等“出故障”；人崩溃也说 break down。
scene: A car stopped on a country road with steam coming from the engine.

senses.en: a printed piece of paper you sign to pay money

ex.en: He paid the rent by cheque.
ex.zh: 他用支票付房租。

ex.en: Can I write you a cheque for the ticket?
ex.zh: 我能给你开张支票付票钱吗？

tip: cheque 是英式拼写，美式拼写是 check。
scene: A person writing on a cheque at a desk with a pen.

senses.en: a game played with pieces on a board

ex.en: We played a board game together last night.
ex.zh: 昨晚我们一起玩了一个桌游。

ex.en: This board game is easy to learn.
ex.zh: 这个桌游很容易学会。

tip: 常见的 board game 有 chess（国际象棋）和 Monopoly 这类游戏。
scene: A family playing a colourful board game around a living room table.

senses.en: used before a noun when it is clear which one

ex.en: The sun is shining today.
ex.zh: 今天阳光明媚。

ex.en: Close the door, please.
ex.zh: 请关上门。

tip: the 用在特指的名词前；元音音素前读 /ðiː/。
scene: A bright sun shining over a house with an open door.

senses.en: a small number of things or people

ex.en: I have a few questions to ask you.
ex.zh: 我有几个问题想问你。

ex.en: She invited a few friends to her birthday party.
ex.zh: 她邀请了几个朋友来参加她的生日聚会。

tip: a few 表示“有一些”，带肯定意味；few 表示“几乎没有”。
scene: A child counting a small handful of colourful marbles on a table.

senses.en: to return to a place

ex.en: When did you come back from holiday?
ex.zh: 你什么时候度假回来的？

ex.en: She will come back home before dinner.
ex.zh: 她会在晚饭前回家。

tip: come back 强调“回到说话人所在的地方”；return 更正式。
scene: A girl with a suitcase walking back to her house and waving.

senses.en: something that belongs to a female person

ex.en: This umbrella is not mine; it's hers.
ex.zh: 这把伞不是我的，是她的。

ex.en: My bag is blue and hers is red.
ex.zh: 我的包是蓝色的，她的是红色的。

tip: hers 是名词性物主代词，后面不再接名词。
scene: Two school bags, a blue one and a red one, side by side on hooks.

senses.en: okay; in a satisfactory way

ex.en: Are you alright? You look tired.
ex.zh: 你还好吗？你看起来很累。

ex.en: We'll meet at eight, alright?
ex.zh: 我们八点见面，行吗？

tip: alright 是 all right 的口语拼写，两者意思相同。
scene: A friend checking on a tired student sitting at a desk at school.

senses.zh: 女士（女性称谓，不限婚否）
senses.en: title used before a woman's surname

ex.en: Ms Lee is the new manager of the shop.
ex.zh: 李女士是这家店的新经理。

ex.en: Please address the letter to Ms Chen.
ex.zh: 请把信寄给陈女士。

tip: Ms 不表明婚否，是现代更常用的女性称谓。
scene: A professional woman with a nameplate reading Ms Lee at an office desk.

senses.en: used to show place, time or state

ex.en: We met at the bus stop at nine.
ex.zh: 我们九点在公交车站见面。

ex.en: She is good at drawing.
ex.zh: 她擅长画画。

tip: at 用于小地点和具体时间点；in 用于大地点和时段。
scene: Two friends waving at a bus stop on a sunny street.

senses.en: pain in your stomach

ex.en: I ate too much and now I have a stomach ache.
ex.zh: 我吃太多，现在肚子疼。

ex.en: She stayed home because of a stomach ache.
ex.zh: 她因为肚子疼待在家里。

tip: stomach ache 是胃/肚子疼；earache 耳朵疼，toothache 牙疼。
scene: A child holding their stomach and sitting on a sofa, looking uncomfortable.

senses.en: instructions about how to get somewhere

ex.en: Can you give me directions to the station?
ex.zh: 你能告诉我去车站怎么走吗？

ex.en: We followed the directions on the map.
ex.zh: 我们按照地图上的路线走。

tip: ask for directions 是“问路”；lose your way 是“迷路”。
scene: A tourist asking for directions from a friendly local on a street corner.

senses.en: to take care of someone or something

ex.en: My sister looks after our cat when we travel.
ex.zh: 我们旅行时，姐姐照顾我们的猫。

ex.en: Please look after your little brother.
ex.zh: 请照顾好你的小弟弟。

tip: look after 等于 take care of，都表示“照顾”。
scene: A girl gently feeding a cat with a bowl of food.

senses.en: happening every day

ex.en: Walking to school is part of my daily routine.
ex.zh: 步行上学是我日常的一部分。

ex.en: She reads the daily news on her phone.
ex.zh: 她每天在手机上看新闻。

tip: daily 既是形容词也是副词：daily exercise 每天锻炼。
scene: A wall calendar with each day crossed off and a toothbrush beside it.

senses.en: the child of your son or daughter

ex.en: Their grandchild visits them every Sunday.
ex.zh: 他们的孙子每周日来看他们。

ex.en: Grandpa loves reading stories to his grandchild.
ex.zh: 爷爷喜欢给孙辈读故事。

tip: grandchild 复数 grandchildren；分性别说 grandson/granddaughter。
scene: A grandfather reading a picture book to a grandchild on a sofa.

senses.en: a male person or animal already mentioned

ex.en: He is my best friend at school.
ex.zh: 他是我在学校最好的朋友。

ex.en: Where is Tom? He is in the garden.
ex.zh: 汤姆在哪？他在花园里。

tip: he 是主格；宾格是 him，形容词性物主代词是 his。
scene: A boy waving from a garden while a friend looks for him.

senses.en: to check that something is true or done

ex.en: Make sure you lock the door before leaving.
ex.zh: 离开前确保锁好门。

ex.en: She made sure all the lights were off.
ex.zh: 她确认所有灯都关了。

tip: make sure (that) + 从句，表示“确保”。
scene: A hand locking a door while holding keys.

senses.en: a deep pan with a handle for cooking

ex.en: She boiled the soup in a saucepan.
ex.zh: 她用炖锅煮汤。

ex.en: Put the saucepan on the stove, please.
ex.zh: 请把炖锅放到炉子上。

tip: saucepan 是带柄的深锅，用来煮汤/炖菜。
scene: A saucepan with soup boiling on a stove.

senses.en: a person who writes computer programs

ex.en: She works as a programmer for a tech company.
ex.zh: 她在一家科技公司当程序员。

ex.en: The programmer fixed the problem in the app.
ex.zh: 程序员修复了应用里的问题。

tip: programmer 是程序员；美式拼写也作 programmer。
scene: A programmer typing code on a computer with two screens.

senses.en: to happen

ex.en: The concert will take place in the town hall.
ex.zh: 音乐会将市政厅举行。

ex.en: The meeting took place last Friday.
ex.zh: 会议上周五举行。

tip: take place 表示“发生/举行”，比 happen 更正式。
scene: A concert taking place in a town hall with an audience.

senses.en: to have the appearance of, or seem

ex.en: He looks like his father.
ex.zh: 他长得像他爸爸。

ex.en: It looks like it's going to snow.
ex.zh: 看起来要下雪了。

tip: look like 表示“长得像/看起来像”。
scene: A boy and his father standing side by side, looking alike.

senses.en: the place in a shop where you pay

ex.en: The checkout has a long queue today.
ex.zh: 今天收银台排着长队。

ex.en: She put her shopping on the checkout counter.
ex.zh: 她把买的东西放在收银台上。

tip: checkout 是超市/商店的收银结账处。
scene: A supermarket checkout counter with a cashier and groceries.

senses.en: a machine that gives you money from your bank account

ex.en: I got some money from the cash machine.
ex.zh: 我从取款机取了些钱。

ex.en: The cash machine is outside the bank.
ex.zh: 取款机在银行外面。

tip: cash machine 是英式说法；美式常说 ATM。
scene: A person using an ATM machine on a street to get cash.

senses.en: using the name of a person or thing

ex.en: The teacher knows every student by name.
ex.zh: 老师认识每个学生的名字。

ex.en: Please address the letter to me by name.
ex.zh: 请把信写上我的名字寄给我。

tip: know sb by name 是“知道某人的名字”。
scene: A teacher calling a student's name from a class list.

senses.en: a report about tomorrow's weather

ex.en: The weather forecast says it will be sunny tomorrow.
ex.zh: 天气预报说明天晴朗。

ex.en: We watched the weather forecast before the trip.
ex.zh: 旅行前我们看了天气预报。

tip: weather forecast 是天气预报；forecast 也作动词“预报”。
scene: A TV weather presenter pointing at a sunny forecast map.

senses.en: to have finished

ex.en: The lesson is over at half past three.
ex.zh: 课三点半结束。

ex.en: When the film was over, we went home.
ex.zh: 电影结束后我们回家了。

tip: be over 表示“结束”；The concert is over. 音乐会结束了。
scene: A classroom clock showing the end of a lesson as students pack up.

senses.en: feeling strong love for someone

ex.en: They are deeply in love with each other.
ex.zh: 他们深深相爱。

ex.en: She fell in love with the city at first sight.
ex.zh: 她第一眼就爱上了这座城市。

tip: fall in love with 是“爱上”；be in love 是“恋爱中”。
scene: A couple holding hands and smiling on a park bench.

senses.en: broken or harmed

ex.en: The damaged bike cannot be ridden anymore.
ex.zh: 这辆损坏的自行车不能再骑了。

ex.en: She returned the damaged phone to the shop.
ex.zh: 她把损坏的手机退回商店。

tip: damaged 是过去分词作形容词“受损的”。
scene: A bicycle with a bent wheel lying beside a wall.

senses.en: a machine that sends copies of documents by phone lines

ex.en: Please send the form by fax.
ex.zh: 请把表格用传真发过来。

ex.en: She faxed the contract to the office.
ex.zh: 她把合同传真到办公室。

tip: fax 可作名词“传真”或动词“发传真”。
scene: An office fax machine sending out a sheet of paper.

senses.en: except for, or in addition to

ex.en: Apart from the weather, the trip was perfect.
ex.zh: 除了天气，这次旅行很完美。

ex.en: Everyone came to the party apart from Tom.
ex.zh: 除了汤姆，大家都来参加聚会了。

tip: apart from 既可表“除了…之外（排除）”，也可表“除了…还（补充）”。
scene: A sunny picnic with an empty chair, everyone there apart from one person.

senses.en: done using hands, not a machine

ex.en: The card was made by hand.
ex.zh: 这张卡片是手工制作的。

ex.en: Please sign the form by hand.
ex.zh: 请用手写签名。

tip: by hand 表示“手工地”；made by hand 手工制作。
scene: Hands folding a paper card with craft materials on a table.

senses.en: now, at this time

ex.en: At present, she is studying in London.
ex.zh: 目前她在伦敦学习。

ex.en: At present, the shop is closed for repairs.
ex.zh: 目前这家店因装修停业。

tip: at present 是书面语“目前”，等于 now/currently。
scene: A London study desk with books, a girl studying at a window.

senses.en: small money given to children by parents

ex.en: She saves her pocket money to buy books.
ex.zh: 她存零花钱买书。

ex.en: My pocket money is ten pounds a week.
ex.zh: 我的零花钱是每周十英镑。

tip: pocket money 是孩子每周的零花钱；美式说 allowance。
scene: A parent giving coins to a happy child.

senses.en: to make something completely full

ex.en: We filled up the car with petrol.
ex.zh: 我们把汽车加满了油。

ex.en: Fill up the bottle with water, please.
ex.zh: 请把瓶子装满水。

col: fill up the tank｜加满油箱
tip: fill up 是“装满/加满”；加油时也说 fill it up。
scene: A car being filled with petrol at a station, tank full.

senses.en: informal way of saying yes

ex.en: 'Are you coming?' 'Yeah, I'll be there.'
ex.zh: “你来吗？”“嗯，我会去的。”

ex.en: Yeah, I really like this song.
ex.zh: 是啊，我真的很喜欢这首歌。

tip: yeah 是 yes 的口语形式，非正式场合用。
scene: A person nodding and saying yeah while talking with a friend.

senses.en: in a good way; also used to start a sentence

ex.en: She sings very well.
ex.zh: 她唱歌唱得很好。

ex.en: Well, let's start the lesson.
ex.zh: 好了，我们开始上课吧。

tip: well 作副词“很好地”；作感叹词引出话题。
scene: A teacher clapping and saying well done to a student.

senses.en: said when you say goodbye at night or go to bed

ex.en: Good night, sleep well.
ex.zh: 晚安，睡个好觉。

ex.en: Mum kissed me and said good night.
ex.zh: 妈妈亲了我一下，说了晚安。

tip: good night 用于道别或睡前；即使天黑见面也用 good evening。
scene: A mother tucking her child into bed and switching off the light.

senses.en: to put on clothes to see if they fit

ex.en: Can I try on this jacket, please?
ex.zh: 请问我可以试穿这件夹克吗？

ex.en: She tried on three dresses before choosing one.
ex.zh: 她试了三件裙子才选了一件。

tip: try on 是“试穿”；try it on 中代词放中间。
scene: A girl trying on a jacket in front of a shop mirror.

senses.en: an informal greeting

ex.en: Hi, how are you today?
ex.zh: 嗨，你今天好吗？

ex.en: She said hi to everyone in the class.
ex.zh: 她向班里的每个人打招呼。

tip: hi 比 hello 更随意，朋友间常用。
scene: A girl waving and saying hi to friends at a school gate.

senses.en: the thing or person here or now

ex.en: This is my favourite book.
ex.zh: 这是我最喜欢的书。

ex.en: This cake tastes wonderful.
ex.zh: 这个蛋糕尝起来很美味。

tip: this 指近处/当前的事物；that 指远处。复数 these。
scene: A hand holding up a colourful book, saying this is my favourite.

senses.en: to move to a sitting position

ex.en: Please sit down and open your books.
ex.zh: 请坐下，打开课本。

ex.en: He sat down next to his friend on the bench.
ex.zh: 他坐在长椅上朋友旁边。

tip: sit down 是“坐下”的动作；反义 stand up（起立）。
scene: Students sitting down at their desks in a classroom.

senses.en: a small hotel or house where people pay to stay

ex.en: We stayed at a lovely guest-house by the beach.
ex.zh: 我们住在海边一家可爱的家庭旅馆。

ex.en: The guest-house serves breakfast every morning.
ex.zh: 这家家庭旅馆每天早上提供早餐。

tip: guest-house 是小型旅馆，通常比酒店便宜、更温馨。
scene: A cosy small guest-house with flowers by the door near a beach.

senses.zh: 名；名字（名字中的第一个词）
senses.en: your personal name, not your family name

ex.en: My first name is Anna and my surname is Green.
ex.zh: 我的名字叫安娜，姓格林。

ex.en: Please write your first name in the box.
ex.zh: 请在方框里写下你的名字。

tip: first name 是“名”，surname/family name 是“姓”。
scene: A form with first name and surname boxes being filled in.

senses.en: to tell someone you are grateful

ex.en: I want to thank you for your help.
ex.zh: 我想感谢你的帮助。

ex.en: She thanked the teacher for the present.
ex.zh: 她感谢老师送的礼物。

tip: thank sb for sth 是“为某事感谢某人”；thank you 是谢谢。
scene: A student thanking a teacher and receiving a wrapped gift.

senses.en: the sport of moving on skates

ex.en: Skating on the frozen lake is great fun.
ex.zh: 在结冰的湖面上滑冰很好玩。

ex.en: She learned skating when she was six.
ex.zh: 她六岁就学会了滑冰。

tip: skating 指溜冰运动；ice skating 特指滑冰。
scene: A girl skating gracefully on an outdoor ice rink.

senses.en: a long board used for surfing on waves

ex.en: He carried his surfboard to the beach.
ex.zh: 他把冲浪板带到海滩。

ex.en: The surfboard floats on the water easily.
ex.zh: 冲浪板很容易浮在水上。

tip: surfboard 是冲浪板；surfing 是冲浪运动。
scene: A colourful surfboard standing in the sand at a sunny beach.

senses.en: sent through the mail

ex.en: I sent the birthday card by post.
ex.zh: 我把生日贺卡寄出去了。

ex.en: You can pay by post or online.
ex.zh: 你可以邮寄付款或在线付款。

tip: by post 是英式说法，美式常说 by mail。
scene: A red postbox with letters and a birthday card being posted.

senses.en: a short announcement or film that tells people about a product

ex.en: I saw an advert for the new phone on TV.
ex.zh: 我在电视上看到新手机的广告。

ex.en: The shop put an advert in the local newspaper.
ex.zh: 这家商店在本地报纸上登了广告。

tip: advert 是英式口语说法，等于 advertisement。
scene: A bright TV screen showing a colourful soft drink advert in a living room.

senses.en: doing a job, or functioning

ex.en: The working hours here are nine to five.
ex.zh: 这里的工作时间是九点到五点。

ex.en: Is the machine still working?
ex.zh: 机器还在运转吗？

tip: working 是“工作的/运转的”；working hours 工作时间。
scene: People working at desks in an open office.

senses.en: to draw a line through something written

ex.en: Cross out the wrong answers on the list.
ex.zh: 把清单上错误的答案划掉。

ex.en: She crossed out a sentence and rewrote it.
ex.zh: 她划掉了一个句子重写。

tip: cross out 表示“用线划掉”。
scene: A hand crossing out a word with a pen on a paper.

senses.en: a strap that keeps you safe in a car

ex.en: Please fasten your seat belt before we drive.
ex.zh: 开车前请系好安全带。

ex.en: Everyone in the car must wear a seat belt.
ex.zh: 车里每个人都要系安全带。

col: fasten your seat belt｜系安全带
tip: fasten/put on your seat belt 是“系安全带”。
scene: A hand fastening a seat belt in a car.

senses.en: finally, after everything

ex.en: In the end, we decided to stay home.
ex.zh: 最后我们决定待在家里。

ex.en: Everything worked out well in the end.
ex.zh: 最后一切都很顺利。

tip: in the end 表示“最终结果”；at the end 是“在…的末尾”。
scene: A family relaxing at home after deciding to stay in.

senses.en: a person who writes a blog

ex.en: She is a food blogger who posts recipes online.
ex.zh: 她是一位在网上分享食谱的美食博主。

ex.en: The blogger wrote about her trip to Japan.
ex.zh: 博主写了她的日本之旅。

tip: blogger 是写博客的人；blog 是博客。
scene: A young woman typing on a laptop at a café table with a camera.

senses.en: cooked food bought to eat at home

ex.en: We ordered a takeaway for dinner.
ex.zh: 我们点了外卖当晚餐。

ex.en: The takeaway round the corner sells pizza.
ex.zh: 拐角的外卖店卖披萨。

tip: takeaway 是英式“外卖”；美式说 take-out。
scene: A takeaway box with pizza being carried out of a shop.

senses.en: to enter a place or vehicle

ex.en: Get in the car; we are leaving now.
ex.zh: 上车吧，我们现在就走。

ex.en: The train gets in at ten.
ex.zh: 火车十点到达。

tip: get in 表示“进入/上车”；车到达也说 get in。
scene: A person getting into a car through the open door.

senses.en: to cut something into small pieces

ex.en: Cut up the vegetables before cooking.
ex.zh: 烹饪前把蔬菜切碎。

ex.en: She cut up the paper into small squares.
ex.zh: 她把纸剪成小方块。

tip: cut up 是“切碎/剪碎”。
scene: Hands chopping vegetables on a cutting board in a kitchen.

senses.en: the amount of snow that falls

ex.en: The city had heavy snowfall last night.
ex.zh: 昨晚这座城市下了大雪。

ex.en: Snowfall in the mountains makes skiing possible.
ex.zh: 山里的降雪使滑雪成为可能。

tip: snowfall 是“降雪/降雪量”。
scene: Snow falling heavily over a small town at night.

senses.en: finally, after a long time

ex.en: At last, the bus arrived!
ex.zh: 公交车终于来了！

ex.en: We finished the project at last.
ex.zh: 我们终于完成了这个项目。

tip: at last 强调“经过等待终于发生”，比 finally 更有感情色彩。
scene: People at a bus stop cheering as the bus finally arrives.

senses.en: a warm soft shirt with long sleeves

ex.en: He wears a blue sweatshirt to school.
ex.zh: 他穿蓝色卫衣上学。

ex.en: This sweatshirt is warm and comfortable.
ex.zh: 这件卫衣又暖和又舒服。

tip: sweatshirt 是运动卫衣；hoodie 是连帽卫衣。
scene: A blue sweatshirt folded on a bed.

senses.en: to register at an airport or hotel

ex.en: We need to check in two hours before the flight.
ex.zh: 我们需要在起飞前两小时办理登机手续。

ex.en: Please check in at the front desk when you arrive.
ex.zh: 到达后请到前台办理入住。

tip: check in 是动词短语；check-in 是名词“值机/入住手续”。
scene: A family checking in at an airport counter with luggage.

senses.en: the bars you hold to steer a bike

ex.en: Hold the handlebars firmly when you ride.
ex.zh: 骑车时握紧车把。

ex.en: The handlebars of the bicycle are too high for me.
ex.zh: 这辆自行车的车把对我来说太高了。

tip: handlebars 常用复数，指自行车/摩托车的车把。
scene: A close view of bicycle handlebars with a rider's hands on them.

senses.en: to give something to each person

ex.en: The volunteers handed out water to the runners.
ex.zh: 志愿者给跑步者分发水。

ex.en: She handed out the invitations at school.
ex.zh: 她在学校分发请柬。

tip: hand out 是“分发”；handout 是名词“讲义”。
scene: Volunteers handing out bottles of water to runners.

senses.en: so that; for the purpose of

ex.en: She studies hard in order to pass the exam.
ex.zh: 她努力学习以便通过考试。

ex.en: In order to save money, we cook at home.
ex.zh: 为了省钱，我们在家做饭。

tip: in order to + 动词原形 表示目的“为了”。
scene: A student studying at night with a goal list on the desk.

senses.en: into two equal parts

ex.en: Cut the apple in half and share it.
ex.zh: 把苹果切成两半分着吃。

ex.en: She folded the paper in half.
ex.zh: 她把纸对折。

tip: cut/divide in half 表示“分成两半”。
scene: A knife cutting an apple in half on a cutting board.

senses.en: a machine that records phone messages

ex.en: She left a message on my answerphone.
ex.zh: 她在我的答录机上留了言。

ex.en: The answerphone recorded three calls while we were out.
ex.zh: 我们外出时答录机录了三个电话。

tip: answerphone 是英式说法，指电话答录机。
scene: An old answerphone machine on a desk with a blinking light.

senses.en: the flat green part of a plant

ex.en: The leaves turn yellow in autumn.
ex.zh: 秋天叶子变黄。

ex.en: A leaf fell from the tree and landed on the path.
ex.zh: 一片叶子从树上落下，落在小路上。

tip: leaf 的复数是 leaves（不规则变化）。
scene: A green leaf with veins falling from a tree in autumn.

senses.en: between young and old, about 40 to 60

ex.en: The middle-aged man walked his dog every day.
ex.zh: 这位中年男子每天遛狗。

ex.en: The book is popular with middle-aged readers.
ex.zh: 这本书受中年读者欢迎。

tip: middle-aged 指中年（约40-60岁）。
scene: A middle-aged man walking his dog in a park.

senses.en: a person who tests or judges exams

ex.en: The examiner asked me three questions.
ex.zh: 考官问了我三个问题。

ex.en: She was nervous when the examiner walked in.
ex.zh: 考官进来时她很紧张。

tip: examiner 是考官，在考试中出题/评分的人。
scene: An examiner sitting at a desk with papers in an exam room.

senses.en: buses and trains that everyone can use

ex.en: Public transport is cheap and convenient here.
ex.zh: 这里公共交通便宜又方便。

ex.en: Many people use public transport to go to work.
ex.zh: 许多人乘公共交通上班。

tip: public transport 是公共交通（公交、地铁、火车）。
scene: A bus and a train moving through a city street.

senses.en: a person who dives under water or jumps into water

ex.en: The diver explored the coral reef.
ex.zh: 潜水员探索了珊瑚礁。

ex.en: The diver jumped into the pool perfectly.
ex.zh: 跳水者完美地跳入泳池。

tip: diver 指潜水员或跳水运动员；diving 是潜水/跳水运动。
scene: A diver in scuba gear swimming near a colourful coral reef.

senses.en: a short video

ex.en: She shared a funny video clip with her friends.
ex.zh: 她给朋友分享了一个搞笑短视频。

ex.en: The video clip of the concert went popular online.
ex.zh: 音乐会的视频片段在网上火了。

tip: video clip 是短视频/片段。
scene: A phone screen playing a short video clip with a play button.

senses.en: short for goalkeeper, or a person who looks after things

ex.en: The keeper caught the ball easily.
ex.zh: 守门员轻松接住了球。

ex.en: The zoo keeper feeds the animals every day.
ex.zh: 动物园管理员每天喂动物。

tip: keeper 常指守门员（goalkeeper 的简称），也指管理员。
scene: A goalkeeper catching a ball in front of the goal.

senses.en: early enough; before the deadline

ex.en: We arrived in time for the film.
ex.zh: 我们及时赶到了，赶上了电影。

ex.en: Finish your homework in time for dinner.
ex.zh: 及时完成作业好赶上晚饭。

tip: in time 是“及时，来得及”；on time 是“准时”。
scene: People rushing into a cinema just before the film starts.

senses.en: having skill from doing something for a long time

ex.en: She is an experienced driver.
ex.zh: 她是一位有经验的司机。

ex.en: The experienced teacher helped the new students.
ex.zh: 经验丰富的老师帮助了新学生。

tip: experienced 是形容词“有经验的”；反义 inexperienced。
scene: An experienced pilot in uniform speaking to young trainees.

senses.en: to move down, or to bring something down

ex.en: Get down from that tree carefully!
ex.zh: 小心地从树上下来！

ex.en: She got the books down from the high shelf.
ex.zh: 她把书从高架子上取下来。

tip: get down 表示“下来”或“取下”。
scene: A child climbing carefully down from a tree.

senses.en: to look after children while their parents are out

ex.en: She babysits for the neighbours on Friday nights.
ex.zh: 她每周五晚上帮邻居照看孩子。

ex.en: I babysit my little cousin when my aunt works.
ex.zh: 姑姑上班时我照看小表弟。

tip: babysit 是动词“照看小孩”；照看者叫 babysitter。
scene: A teenager reading a picture book to a small child on a sofa.

senses.en: to reduce sound, or to refuse

ex.en: Please turn down the music; it's too loud.
ex.zh: 请把音乐调小，太吵了。

ex.en: She turned down the job offer.
ex.zh: 她拒绝了这份工作邀请。

tip: turn down 表示“调低”或“拒绝”。
scene: A person turning down the volume on a stereo.

senses.en: a flat pan used for frying food

ex.en: Heat the frying pan before adding the oil.
ex.zh: 先加热煎锅再放油。

ex.en: She put the frying pan on the stove.
ex.zh: 她把煎锅放到炉子上。

tip: frying pan 是平底煎锅；美式常说 skillet。
scene: A frying pan on a stove with oil sizzling.

senses.en: the sport of moving on ice wearing skates

ex.en: We go ice skating every winter.
ex.zh: 我们每年冬天都去滑冰。

ex.en: Ice skating is fun but you have to be careful.
ex.zh: 滑冰很有趣，但要小心。

tip: ice skating 是“滑冰”运动；ice skates 是冰鞋。
scene: A child gliding on an ice rink with other skaters around.

senses.en: a woman who works in business

ex.en: My aunt is a successful businesswoman.
ex.zh: 我姑姑是一位成功的女企业家。

ex.en: The businesswoman held a meeting with her team.
ex.zh: 这位女商人召集团队开了会。

tip: businesswoman 复数形式是 businesswomen。
scene: A confident woman in a smart suit giving a presentation in an office.

senses.en: available to be bought

ex.en: There is a sign that says 'for sale' outside the house.
ex.zh: 房子外面有一块写着“出售”的牌子。

ex.en: These paintings are not for sale.
ex.zh: 这些画是非卖品。

tip: for sale 是“待出售”；on sale 是“打折促销中”。
scene: A house with a for sale sign standing in a garden.

senses.en: to make a place clean and neat

ex.en: Please tidy up your room before dinner.
ex.zh: 晚饭前请整理好你的房间。

ex.en: We tidied up the classroom after the party.
ex.zh: 聚会后我们收拾了教室。

tip: tidy up 是“收拾整理”；tidy 是形容词“整洁的”。
scene: A child putting toys into a box to tidy up a bedroom.

senses.en: a telephone you can carry with you

ex.en: My cell phone battery is dead.
ex.zh: 我的手机没电了。

ex.en: She checks her cell phone every morning.
ex.zh: 她每天早上看手机。

tip: cell phone 是美式说法；英式常说 mobile phone。
scene: A smartphone on a desk showing a low battery warning.

senses.en: to wash the dishes, or wash yourself

ex.en: After dinner, we wash up the plates.
ex.zh: 晚饭后我们洗盘子。

ex.en: He washed up before lunch.
ex.zh: 他午饭前洗了手脸。

tip: 英式 wash up 是“洗碗”；美式 wash up 是“洗手洗脸”。
scene: Hands washing plates in a kitchen sink with soap bubbles.

senses.en: a piece of clothing you wear for swimming

ex.en: She bought a new bathing suit for the beach holiday.
ex.zh: 她为海滩度假买了一件新泳衣。

ex.en: Don't forget your bathing suit and towel.
ex.zh: 别忘了带泳衣和毛巾。

tip: bathing suit 常见于美式英语；英式常说 swimsuit。
scene: A bright swimming costume and a towel laid on a beach chair.

senses.en: a style of music and dance from the city

ex.en: He loves listening to hip hop music.
ex.zh: 他喜欢听嘻哈音乐。

ex.en: They learned hip hop dance at the club.
ex.zh: 他们在俱乐部学街舞。

tip: hip hop 既指嘻哈音乐，也指嘻哈文化/街舞。
scene: A teenager dancing to hip hop music with headphones on in a room.

senses.en: to look at something to make sure it is right

ex.en: Check your answers before you hand in the paper.
ex.zh: 交卷前检查一下你的答案。

ex.en: I need to check the train times online.
ex.zh: 我需要在网上查一下火车时间。

col: check in｜办理登机/入住手续
tip: check 常与 in 搭配：check in 表示办理登机或入住手续。
scene: A student double-checking answers on a test paper with a pen.

senses.en: to return something to its owner

ex.en: Don't forget to give back the library book.
ex.zh: 别忘了把图书馆的书还回去。

ex.en: She gave back the money she borrowed.
ex.zh: 她把借的钱还了。

tip: give back 强调“归还给别人”；give it back 中 it 放中间。
scene: A student returning a library book at the library desk.

senses.en: a piece of clothing worn for swimming

ex.en: She packed her swimsuit for the holiday.
ex.zh: 她把泳衣装进行李去度假。

ex.en: This swimsuit is perfect for the beach.
ex.zh: 这件泳衣很适合去海滩。

tip: swimsuit 是泳衣；男士泳裤说 swimming trunks。
scene: A bright swimsuit hanging on a line by a sunny pool.

senses.en: a machine that gives cash (British English)

ex.en: There's a cashpoint around the corner.
ex.zh: 拐角处有一台取款机。

ex.en: I need to find a cashpoint to get money.
ex.zh: 我需要找台取款机取钱。

tip: cashpoint 是英式说法，等于 ATM。
scene: A cashpoint machine on a shop wall with a person using it.

senses.en: an arrangement with a bank to keep your money

ex.en: She opened a bank account to save her pocket money.
ex.zh: 她开了个银行账户存零花钱。

ex.en: You need your ID to open a bank account.
ex.zh: 开银行账户需要身份证件。

col: open a bank account｜开银行账户
tip: open a bank account 是“开户”；save money 存钱。
scene: A person signing a form at a bank counter.

senses.en: if; on condition that

ex.en: You can borrow the book as long as you return it.
ex.zh: 只要你归还，就可以借这本书。

ex.en: We'll play football as long as it doesn't rain.
ex.zh: 只要不下雨，我们就踢足球。

tip: as long as 引导条件从句，表示“只要”。
scene: Children playing football in a park while the sky stays clear.

senses.en: the rise in the earth's temperature

ex.en: Global warming is caused partly by pollution.
ex.zh: 全球变暖部分是由污染造成的。

ex.en: Many countries are working to stop global warming.
ex.zh: 许多国家正在努力阻止全球变暖。

tip: global warming 是“全球变暖”，与 climate change 相关。
scene: A hot sun over melting ice with factories in the distance.

senses.en: very dark blue

ex.en: She wore a navy blue jacket to the interview.
ex.zh: 她穿了一件藏青色夹克去面试。

ex.en: The school uniform is navy blue.
ex.zh: 校服是藏青色的。

tip: navy blue 是深蓝/藏青色。
scene: A navy blue jacket hanging on a hanger.

senses.en: to look after someone or something

ex.en: She takes care of her younger brother.
ex.zh: 她照顾弟弟。

ex.en: Please take care of the problem before Friday.
ex.zh: 请在周五前处理这个问题。

tip: take care of 是“照顾/处理”，等于 look after。
scene: A girl giving water to a plant she takes care of.

senses.en: to arrive, or to increase sound

ex.en: He turned up at the party with his friends.
ex.zh: 他和朋友们出现在聚会上。

ex.en: Turn up the radio; I can't hear it.
ex.zh: 把收音机调大声，我听不见。

tip: turn up 表示“出现”或“调高”。
scene: A guest arriving at a party door with a gift.

senses.en: made smaller or cheaper

ex.en: The reduced prices attracted many customers.
ex.zh: 降价吸引了许多顾客。

ex.en: She bought the jacket at a reduced price.
ex.zh: 她以折扣价买了这件夹克。

tip: reduced 表示“减价/降低的”；at a reduced price 打折价。
scene: A shop rack with red reduced price tags on clothes.

senses.en: not working (about machines)

ex.en: The lift is out of order, so use the stairs.
ex.zh: 电梯故障，请走楼梯。

ex.en: The ticket machine is out of order today.
ex.zh: 售票机今天出故障了。

tip: out of order 表示机器“故障/不能使用”。
scene: A lift with an out of order sign and people using the stairs.

senses.en: to hand things to people, or to produce

ex.en: The teacher gave out the test papers.
ex.zh: 老师分发了试卷。

ex.en: The fire gives out a lot of heat.
ex.zh: 火散发出很多热量。

tip: give out 是“分发”或“发出（光热）”。
scene: A teacher handing out papers to students in class.

senses.en: something happened regularly in the past but not now

ex.en: I used to play the piano when I was young.
ex.zh: 我年轻时曾经常弹钢琴。

ex.en: She used to live in this street.
ex.zh: 她以前住在这条街上。

tip: used to + 动词原形表示过去的习惯；be used to doing 是“习惯做”。
scene: An old piano in a corner, remembering the past.

senses.en: to join or register for something

ex.en: She signed up for the swimming course.
ex.zh: 她报名参加了游泳课程。

ex.en: You can sign up for the newsletter online.
ex.zh: 你可以在网上注册订阅新闻通讯。

tip: sign up for 是“报名参加”。
scene: A person filling in a registration form at a sports centre.

senses.en: to place something down, or to write down

ex.en: Put down your bag and sit down.
ex.zh: 放下包，坐下来。

ex.en: Put down your name on the list.
ex.zh: 在名单上写下你的名字。

tip: put down 表示“放下”或“记下”。
scene: A person putting a heavy bag down on the floor.

senses.en: to connect someone on the phone

ex.en: Please put me through to the manager.
ex.zh: 请帮我接通经理。

ex.en: She was put through to the wrong department.
ex.zh: 她被接到了错误的部门。

tip: put through 是电话用语“接通”。
scene: A receptionist on the phone connecting a caller.

senses.en: a soft warm quilt for a bed

ex.en: I bought a new duvet for the winter.
ex.zh: 我买了一条新羽绒被过冬。

ex.en: The bed has a white duvet and soft pillows.
ex.zh: 床上有白色羽绒被和柔软的枕头。

tip: duvet 是英式说法，指羽绒被。
scene: A cosy bed with a thick white duvet and pillows.

senses.en: on holiday (American English)

ex.en: They are on vacation in Hawaii.
ex.zh: 他们在夏威夷度假。

ex.en: The office is closed because the boss is on vacation.
ex.zh: 老板去度假了，办公室关门。

tip: on vacation 是美式说法；英式说 on holiday。
scene: A couple with beach bags walking on a tropical beach.

senses.en: to remain in a place after others leave

ex.en: A few students stayed behind to ask questions.
ex.zh: 几个学生留下来问问题。

ex.en: Please stay behind after the meeting for a moment.
ex.zh: 会后请留一下。

tip: stay behind 表示“留在原处（别人走后）”。
scene: A student staying behind to talk to the teacher after class.

senses.en: a school for young children

ex.en: My son goes to the local primary school.
ex.zh: 我儿子在本地小学上学。

ex.en: Primary school starts at nine in the morning.
ex.zh: 小学早上九点上课。

tip: primary school 是英式“小学”；美式说 elementary school。
scene: A primary school building with young children at the gate.

senses.en: good wishes sent to someone

ex.en: Please give my regards to your parents.
ex.zh: 请代我向你父母问好。

ex.en: With best regards, Anna.
ex.zh: 此致最美好的祝愿，安娜。

col: best regards｜致以最美好的祝愿
tip: best regards 是信件结尾敬语；give my regards to 是“代我问候”。
scene: A person signing a letter with best regards at a desk.

senses.en: in the beginning, before later

ex.en: At first, the maths problem seemed difficult.
ex.zh: 起初这道数学题看起来很难。

ex.en: At first I didn't like the city, but now I love it.
ex.zh: 一开始我不喜欢这座城市，现在我很喜欢。

tip: at first 表示“最初”，常与 later/now 形成对比。
scene: A student frowning at a maths problem, then smiling after solving it.

senses.en: information telling you how to do something

ex.en: Read the instructions before you use the machine.
ex.zh: 使用机器前请阅读说明书。

ex.en: The instructions on the box are easy to follow.
ex.zh: 盒子上的说明很容易照着做。

tip: instructions 常用复数，指使用说明或操作指示。
scene: A person reading a printed instruction sheet while assembling a shelf.

senses.en: a person who plays football

ex.en: She is a talented footballer on the school team.
ex.zh: 她是校队里很有天赋的足球运动员。

ex.en: The footballer waved to the fans after the game.
ex.zh: 比赛结束后，这位足球运动员向球迷挥手。

tip: footballer 是英式常用说法，即足球运动员。
scene: A footballer in a team jersey waving to cheering fans in a stadium.

senses.en: not anybody

ex.en: No one was in the classroom after school.
ex.zh: 放学后教室里没有人。

ex.en: She called, but no one answered.
ex.zh: 她打了电话，但没人接。

tip: no one 和 nobody 同义，都是“没有人”；谓语用单数。
scene: An empty classroom with desks and chairs but no students.

senses.en: a person who plays football

ex.en: His dream is to become a famous football player.
ex.zh: 他的梦想是成为著名的足球运动员。

ex.en: The football player scored two goals in the match.
ex.zh: 这名足球运动员在比赛中进了两个球。

tip: football player 和 footballer 意思相同，都是足球运动员。
scene: A footballer in a red shirt kicking a ball towards a goal.

senses.en: to leave home to do something

ex.en: We are going out for dinner tonight.
ex.zh: 我们今晚出去吃晚饭。

ex.en: She goes out with her friends every Saturday.
ex.zh: 她每周六和朋友一起出去。

col: go out with someone｜和某人约会
tip: go out 表示“外出”；go out with sb 表示“与某人交往”。
scene: Two friends walking out of the front door together in the evening.

senses.en: earphones you wear over your head to listen to music

ex.en: She listens to English songs with headphones on.
ex.zh: 她戴着耳机听英文歌。

ex.en: He put on his headphones and started studying.
ex.zh: 他戴上耳机开始学习。

col: a pair of headphones｜一副耳机
tip: headphones 常用复数；一副耳机说 a pair of headphones。
scene: A pair of black headphones lying on a desk next to a laptop.

senses.en: feeling pleased and cheerful

ex.en: The children look happy playing in the garden.
ex.zh: 孩子们在花园里玩得很开心。

ex.en: I am happy to help you with your homework.
ex.zh: 我很乐意帮你做作业。

tip: happy 的名词是 happiness；be happy with 表示“对…满意”。
scene: Happy children laughing and playing with a ball in a sunny garden.

senses.en: a large white bear that lives in the Arctic

ex.en: Polar bears live in very cold places.
ex.zh: 北极熊生活在非常寒冷的地方。

ex.en: We saw a polar bear on the documentary.
ex.zh: 我们在纪录片里看到了一只北极熊。

tip: polar bear 是北极熊，生活在北极，毛是白色的。
scene: A white polar bear walking on snowy ice with mountains behind.

senses.en: a card with your name and photo to prove who you are

ex.en: She showed her ID card to the security guard.
ex.zh: 她向保安出示了身份证。

ex.en: Don't forget your ID card when you travel.
ex.zh: 出门旅行别忘了带身份证。

tip: ID card 即身份证/证件卡；英美出行常带 passport 或 driving licence。
scene: A student ID card with a photo lying on a desk.

senses.en: a word you say when leaving or finishing a call

ex.en: She waved goodbye to her grandparents.
ex.zh: 她向祖父母挥手告别。

ex.en: We said goodbye and got on the train.
ex.zh: 我们道别后上了火车。

tip: goodbye 较正式；bye 更口语。道别用 say goodbye to。
scene: A girl waving goodbye to her grandparents at a train station.

senses.en: a large shop that sells many different kinds of things

ex.en: The department store sells clothes, toys and food.
ex.zh: 这家百货商店卖衣服、玩具和食品。

ex.en: We bought a new lamp in the department store.
ex.zh: 我们在百货商店买了一盏新台灯。

tip: department store 是大型综合商店，分成很多“部门”(department)。
scene: A large bright department store with escalators and many shelves.

senses.en: going a long way down from the top

ex.en: Be careful, the water here is very deep.
ex.zh: 小心，这里的水很深。

ex.en: They dug a deep hole for the tree.
ex.zh: 他们为那棵树挖了一个深坑。

tip: deep 的反义词是 shallow（浅的）；deeply 表示“深深地”。
scene: A deep blue swimming pool where a swimmer checks the depth sign.

senses.en: websites and apps where people share things online

ex.en: She shares photos of her dog on social media.
ex.zh: 她在社交媒体上分享她的狗的照片。

ex.en: Social media helps us keep in touch with friends.
ex.zh: 社交媒体帮助我们和朋友保持联系。

tip: social media 是社交媒体，如微博、微信朋友圈等平台。
scene: A smartphone showing social media posts with hearts and comments.

senses.en: the good or bad things that happen by chance

ex.en: Good luck with your exam tomorrow!
ex.zh: 祝你明天考试好运！

ex.en: She had no luck finding a parking space.
ex.zh: 她运气不好，没找到停车位。

tip: good luck 是祝福语；lucky 是形容词“幸运的”。
scene: A four-leaf clover lying on a desk next to a good luck card.

senses.en: many different types of something

ex.en: The market sells all kinds of fruit and vegetables.
ex.zh: 这个市场卖各种各样的水果和蔬菜。

ex.en: People use computers for all kinds of things.
ex.zh: 人们用电脑做各种各样的事情。

tip: all kinds of 后面接可数名词复数或不可数名词。
scene: A busy market stall piled with many different kinds of fruit.

senses.en: an office where tourists get maps and advice

ex.en: We got a city map at the tourist information centre.
ex.zh: 我们在游客信息中心拿到了一张城市地图。

ex.en: The tourist information centre is open every day.
ex.zh: 游客信息中心每天开放。

tip: 游客信息中心提供地图、路线建议等服务。
scene: A tourist information centre with an i sign and a visitor getting a map.

senses.en: informal word for grandfather

ex.en: Grandpa tells funny stories about his childhood.
ex.zh: 爷爷讲他童年时的趣事。

ex.en: My grandpa grows vegetables in the garden.
ex.zh: 我爷爷在花园里种蔬菜。

tip: grandpa 是 grandfather 的口语说法。
scene: A grandfather watering vegetables in a garden with a watering can.

senses.en: something that belongs to me

ex.en: This bicycle is mine, not yours.
ex.zh: 这辆自行车是我的，不是你的。

ex.en: My phone is black and hers is white. Wait, mine is blue.
ex.zh: 我的手机是黑色的，她的是白色的。等等，我的是蓝色的。

tip: mine 是名词性物主代词，后面不接名词。
scene: A blue bicycle standing in front of a school bike rack.

senses.en: used when an animal or thing does something to itself

ex.en: The cat cleaned itself in the sun.
ex.zh: 猫在阳光下给自己梳理毛发。

ex.en: The door closes by itself.
ex.zh: 门自己会关上。

tip: by itself 表示“自动地/独自地”，如门自动关上。
scene: A cat licking its paw while sitting in a sunny window.

senses.en: to take something back to where it was

ex.en: Please bring back my book tomorrow.
ex.zh: 请明天把我的书带回来。

ex.en: She brought back some gifts from her trip.
ex.zh: 她旅行带回来一些礼物。

tip: bring back 和 take back 都表示“带回”，bring 强调带回来，take 强调带走。
scene: A girl handing a book back to her friend at school.

senses.en: small British money; 100 pence in a pound

ex.en: The sweets cost fifty pence.
ex.zh: 这些糖果五十便士。

ex.en: I have one pound and twenty pence.
ex.zh: 我有一英镑二十便士。

tip: pence 是 penny 的复数（金额时用），如 20 pence。
scene: A handful of British coins on a shop counter.

senses.en: a place where you buy petrol for cars

ex.en: We stopped at a petrol station to fill the car.
ex.zh: 我们在加油站停车加油。

ex.en: The petrol station is open all night.
ex.zh: 这家加油站通宵营业。

tip: petrol station 是英式说法；美式说 gas station。
scene: A car being filled with fuel at a petrol station with a price sign.

senses.en: to direct your eyes towards something

ex.en: Look at the picture and answer the questions.
ex.zh: 看这幅图并回答问题。

ex.en: He looked at the clock and hurried out.
ex.zh: 他看了看钟，匆匆出去了。

tip: look at 是“看着某物”；watch 是“注视动态画面”，如看电视。
scene: A student looking closely at a picture book at a desk.

senses.en: a document that proves who you are

ex.en: You need your ID to open a bank account.
ex.zh: 开银行账户需要身份证件。

ex.en: Please show your ID at the gate.
ex.zh: 请在门口出示证件。

tip: ID 是 identification 的缩写，ID card 是身份证。
scene: A hand holding an ID card in front of a security desk.

senses.en: informal word for grandmother

ex.en: Grandma bakes the best apple pie.
ex.zh: 奶奶烤的苹果派最好吃。

ex.en: We visited my grandma in the countryside.
ex.zh: 我们去乡下看望了外婆。

tip: grandma 是 grandmother 的口语说法；granny 也常用。
scene: A grandmother with grey hair baking an apple pie in a kitchen.

senses.en: a machine that plays CDs

ex.en: My old CD player still works well.
ex.zh: 我的旧光盘播放机还能用。

ex.en: She listened to music on her CD player.
ex.zh: 她用光盘播放机听音乐。

tip: 现在大家多用手机听歌，CD player 是较旧的设备。
scene: A small CD player on a shelf with headphones next to it.

senses.en: to exercise, or to find the answer

ex.en: She works out at the gym three times a week.
ex.zh: 她每周去健身房锻炼三次。

ex.en: Can you work out the answer to this problem?
ex.zh: 你能算出这道题的答案吗？

tip: work out 有“锻炼、算出、解决”等多个意思。
scene: A person exercising on a treadmill at a gym.

senses.en: a person who makes bread and cakes

ex.en: The baker makes fresh bread every morning.
ex.zh: 面包师每天早上做新鲜面包。

ex.en: She bought a cake from the local baker.
ex.zh: 她从当地面包师那里买了一个蛋糕。

tip: baker 是面包师；bakery 是面包店。
scene: A baker in an apron taking fresh bread out of an oven.

senses.en: a sport where you jump over a high bar

ex.en: She won the high jump at the sports day.
ex.zh: 她在运动会上赢得了跳高冠军。

ex.en: The high jump needs strong legs.
ex.zh: 跳高需要强壮的腿部力量。

tip: high jump 是跳高；long jump 是跳远。
scene: An athlete jumping over a high bar on a sports field.

senses.en: a place where two roads cross

ex.en: Turn left at the crossroads.
ex.zh: 在十字路口向左转。

ex.en: There is a shop at the crossroads.
ex.zh: 十字路口有一家商店。

tip: crossroads 单复数同形；at the crossroads 在十字路口。
scene: A crossroads with cars and a signpost in a town.

senses.en: a sweater you pull over your head

ex.en: He wore a warm pullover in winter.
ex.zh: 冬天他穿一件保暖套头毛衣。

ex.en: This grey pullover is my favourite.
ex.zh: 这件灰色套头毛衣是我的最爱。

tip: pullover 是套头毛衣；美式说 sweater。
scene: A grey pullover folded on a bed in a bedroom.

senses.en: the sport of racing cars

ex.en: Motor-racing is a dangerous but exciting sport.
ex.zh: 赛车是一项危险但刺激的运动。

ex.en: He watches motor-racing on TV every weekend.
ex.zh: 他每周末在电视上看赛车。

tip: motor-racing 是赛车运动，车手叫 racing driver。
scene: Racing cars speeding around a track at high speed.

senses.en: a person who introduces a TV or radio show

ex.en: The presenter welcomed the guests on the show.
ex.zh: 主持人在节目里欢迎嘉宾。

ex.en: She works as a news presenter.
ex.zh: 她是一名新闻主持人。

tip: presenter 是节目主持人；host 也指主持人。
scene: A TV presenter speaking into a microphone in a studio.

senses.en: very surprising and upsetting

ex.en: The news about the accident was shocking.
ex.zh: 关于事故的消息令人震惊。

ex.en: It is shocking how much plastic is in the sea.
ex.zh: 海里塑料之多令人震惊。

tip: shocking 形容事物；shocked 形容人的感受。
scene: A person reading shocking news on a phone, hand over mouth.

senses.en: a jacket and trousers worn for sport

ex.en: He wears a tracksuit for morning running.
ex.zh: 他穿运动套装晨跑。

ex.en: The team trained in matching tracksuits.
ex.zh: 队员们穿着配套的运动套装训练。

tip: tracksuit 是运动服套装（上衣+裤子）。
scene: A grey tracksuit hanging on a hanger in a sports shop.

senses.en: the railway system (American English)

ex.en: The railroad crosses the whole country.
ex.zh: 这条铁路贯穿全国。

ex.en: They took photos of the old railroad station.
ex.zh: 他们拍了旧火车站的照片。

tip: railroad 是美式说法；英式说 railway。
scene: A train running along railroad tracks across green fields.

senses.en: involving all the usual working or studying hours
for all the usual working or studying hours

ex.en: My sister starts her first full-time job next week.
ex.zh: 我姐姐下周开始做她的第一份全职工作。

ex.en: Affordable childcare enables more parents to return to full-time employment without placing excessive pressure on family finances.
ex.zh: 负担得起的托育服务使更多家长能够重返全职工作，同时不会给家庭经济带来过大压力。

tip: 修饰名词时保留连字符，如a full-time job。

senses.en: a person who swims

ex.en: The swimmer won a gold medal at the games.
ex.zh: 这名游泳运动员在运动会上赢得金牌。

ex.en: She is a strong swimmer.
ex.zh: 她是一个游泳好手。

tip: swimmer 是游泳者/游泳运动员。
scene: A swimmer racing in a pool lane with water splashing.

senses.en: calm and relaxed in character

ex.en: Our new teacher is very easygoing.
ex.zh: 我们的新老师很随和。

ex.en: She is easygoing and gets on with everyone.
ex.zh: 她很随和，和每个人都合得来。

tip: easygoing 形容人随和、不挑剔。
scene: A relaxed teacher smiling with students in a classroom.

senses.en: pain in your ear

ex.en: The child cried because of an earache.
ex.zh: 孩子因为耳朵疼哭了起来。

ex.en: She has an earache after swimming.
ex.zh: 游泳后她耳朵疼。

tip: earache 耳朵疼；toothache 牙疼；stomach ache 肚子疼。
scene: A child holding their ear and looking uncomfortable in bed.

senses.en: to keep something inside, or to stop someone going out

ex.en: We had to keep in the cat during the storm.
ex.zh: 暴风雨期间我们只能把猫关在家里。

ex.en: Keep your hands in your pockets to stay warm.
ex.zh: 把手放在口袋里保暖。

tip: keep in 表示“关在屋内/放在里面”。
scene: A cat looking out of a window while kept inside a house.

senses.en: because of

ex.en: The match was cancelled due to heavy rain.
ex.zh: 比赛因大雨被取消。

ex.en: The delay was due to a technical problem.
ex.zh: 延误是由于技术问题。

tip: due to 是正式说法，等于 because of，后接名词。
scene: A rainy football pitch with an umbrella and a cancelled sign.

senses.en: next; coming after something

ex.en: The following day, we visited the museum.
ex.zh: 第二天我们参观了博物馆。

ex.en: Please answer the following questions.
ex.zh: 请回答以下问题。

tip: the following day 是“第二天”；following 也作“以下的”。
scene: A calendar with the next day circled after today.

senses.en: to start a business or arrange equipment

ex.en: They set up a small company last year.
ex.zh: 他们去年创办了一家小公司。

ex.en: Help me set up the tent, please.
ex.zh: 请帮我搭帐篷。

tip: set up 表示“建立、安装、创办”。
scene: Two people setting up a tent in a campsite.

senses.en: to need, to demand, or to collect someone

ex.en: This difficult task calls for great patience.
ex.zh: 这项艰巨的任务需要极大的耐心。

ex.en: I'll call for you at eight before the party.
ex.zh: 聚会前我八点来接你。

tip: call for 表示“需要/要求”，也可表示“去接某人”。
scene: A clock showing eight while a person waits by the door with a coat.

senses.en: small enough to hold in your hand

ex.en: He played games on a hand-held device.
ex.zh: 他在手持设备上玩游戏。

ex.en: A hand-held camera filmed the street scenes.
ex.zh: 一台手持摄像机拍摄了街景。

tip: hand-held 是“手持的”，如掌上游戏机。
scene: A small hand-held game device in a person's hands.

senses.en: to arrive or appear somewhere

ex.en: He didn't show up for the meeting.
ex.zh: 他没有出现在会议上。

ex.en: She showed up ten minutes late.
ex.zh: 她迟到了十分钟才露面。

tip: show up 是口语“出现/露面”，等于 turn up。
scene: An empty chair at a meeting table with people waiting.

senses.en: things given for winning

ex.en: The winners received their prizes at the ceremony.
ex.zh: 获奖者在典礼上领了奖。

ex.en: There are three prizes for the best projects.
ex.zh: 最佳项目有三个奖项。

tip: prizes 是 prize 的复数，奖品/奖金。
scene: A table with shiny trophies and certificates for winners.

senses.en: informal word for mother

ex.en: Mum makes the best soup in the world.
ex.zh: 妈妈做的汤是世界上最好喝的。

ex.en: I told my mum about the school trip.
ex.zh: 我把学校旅行的事告诉了妈妈。

tip: mum 是英式说法；美式说 mom。
scene: A mother stirring soup in a kitchen while a child watches.

senses.en: to feel excited about something in the future

ex.en: I look forward to seeing you next week.
ex.zh: 我期待下周见到你。

ex.en: The children look forward to the school trip.
ex.zh: 孩子们期待学校旅行。

tip: look forward to + 名词/动名词，注意 to 后接动名词。
scene: A child looking happily at a calendar counting down to a trip.

senses.en: not on purpose

ex.en: I took your umbrella by mistake.
ex.zh: 我不小心拿错了你的伞。

ex.en: She deleted the file by mistake.
ex.zh: 她不小心删除了文件。

tip: by mistake 与 by accident 都表示“意外地”；on purpose 是“故意”。
scene: A person holding two umbrellas, realizing one was taken by mistake.

senses.en: a person who makes films

ex.en: The film maker won an award for the movie.
ex.zh: 这位电影制作人因这部电影获奖。

ex.en: She is a young film maker from London.
ex.zh: 她是一位来自伦敦的年轻电影制作人。

tip: film maker 是电影制作者，可指导演/制片人。
scene: A film maker holding a camera on a film set.

senses.en: not certain about something

ex.en: I am unsure about the answer to this question.
ex.zh: 我不确定这道题的答案。

ex.en: She felt unsure about taking the job.
ex.zh: 她不确定是否接受这份工作。

tip: be unsure about/of 是“对…没把握”。
scene: A student hesitating with a hand half-raised in class.

senses.en: a TV drama shown regularly about people's lives

ex.en: My grandmother watches a soap opera every evening.
ex.zh: 我奶奶每天晚上看肥皂剧。

ex.en: The soap opera has been on TV for twenty years.
ex.zh: 这部肥皂剧已经播了二十年。

tip: soap opera 是肥皂剧，剧情连续、贴近生活。
scene: A TV showing a drama scene with a family watching on a sofa.

senses.en: at the greatest distance

ex.en: The furthest town is about fifty kilometres away.
ex.zh: 最远的城镇大约五十公里远。

ex.en: Who can throw the ball the furthest?
ex.zh: 谁能把球扔得最远？

tip: furthest 是 far 的最高级之一（far-farther-furthest）。
scene: A map with a red dot marking the furthest town on a road.

senses.en: to do or complete a task

ex.en: The team carried out the plan successfully.
ex.zh: 团队成功执行了计划。

ex.en: Scientists carried out a survey of local birds.
ex.zh: 科学家对当地鸟类进行了调查。

col: carry out a survey｜进行调查
tip: carry out 表示“执行计划、进行调查”等。
scene: Scientists with clipboards observing birds in a field.

senses.en: boots with blades for ice skating

ex.en: She laced up her ice skates carefully.
ex.zh: 她仔细系好冰鞋鞋带。

ex.en: My ice skates are a bit tight.
ex.zh: 我的冰鞋有点紧。

col: a pair of ice skates｜一双冰鞋
tip: ice skates 是滑冰冰鞋，常用复数。
scene: A pair of white ice skates with blades on an ice rink.

senses.en: to leave a bus, train, bike or horse

ex.en: We get off the bus at the next stop.
ex.zh: 我们在下一站下车。

ex.en: Please get off your bike at the gate.
ex.zh: 请在门口下车（自行车）。

col: get off the bus｜下公交车
tip: get off 表示“下车/下马”；反义词是 get on（上车）。
scene: Passengers stepping down from a bus at a city bus stop.

senses.en: a cold sweet food made from milk and sugar

ex.en: I'd like a chocolate ice cream, please.
ex.zh: 请给我一个巧克力冰淇淋。

ex.en: The children ate ice cream in the summer sun.
ex.zh: 孩子们在夏日阳光下吃冰淇淋。

tip: ice cream 是可数/不可数兼有：an ice cream 一个冰淇淋。
scene: A girl holding a strawberry ice cream cone on a sunny street.

senses.en: a piece of something, or a role in a play

ex.en: This is the best part of the film.
ex.zh: 这是电影最好的部分。

ex.en: She played the main part in the school play.
ex.zh: 她在学校演出中扮演主角。

tip: take part in 是“参加活动”；play a part 是“扮演角色”。
scene: A stage with a girl in a costume taking a bow in the spotlight.

senses.en: from inside to outside

ex.en: She took a book out of her bag.
ex.zh: 她从包里拿出一本书。

ex.en: He ran out of the room in a hurry.
ex.zh: 他匆忙跑出房间。

tip: out of 表示“从…出来”；反义词是 into（进入）。
scene: A girl taking a book out of her school bag at a desk.

senses.en: a camera that stores photos electronically

ex.en: She took lots of photos with her digital camera.
ex.zh: 她用数码相机拍了很多照片。

ex.en: A digital camera is easy to use for beginners.
ex.zh: 数码相机对初学者来说很容易使用。

tip: digital camera 存照片用内存卡，不依赖胶卷。
scene: A small silver digital camera in someone's hands at a tourist spot.

senses.en: used for direction, receiving, or with verbs

ex.en: We walked to the park.
ex.zh: 我们走到公园。

ex.en: I want to learn English.
ex.zh: 我想学英语。

tip: to 表方向“到…”；也用于动词不定式 to do。
scene: A path leading from houses to a green park.

senses.en: the teacher in charge of a school

ex.en: The headteacher gave a speech at the school assembly.
ex.zh: 校长在全校集会上讲话。

ex.en: Our headteacher knows every student by name.
ex.zh: 我们的校长知道每个学生的名字。

tip: headteacher 是英式说法，美式常说 principal。
scene: A headteacher in a suit speaking to students in a school hall.

senses.en: used to show purpose, who receives, or duration

ex.en: This gift is for you.
ex.zh: 这份礼物是给你的。

ex.en: We stayed in London for three days.
ex.zh: 我们在伦敦待了三天。

col: for a long time｜很长时间
tip: for 后接时间段表示“持续多久”；since 后接时间点表示“自从”。
scene: A wrapped gift with a ribbon being handed to a smiling girl.

senses.en: a young cat

ex.en: The kitten is playing with a ball of wool.
ex.zh: 小猫在玩毛线球。

ex.en: We adopted a kitten from the animal shelter.
ex.zh: 我们从动物收容所领养了一只小猫。

tip: kitten 是小猫；成年猫是 cat。
scene: A tiny orange kitten playing with a ball of wool on a carpet.

senses.en: to stop a machine or light working

ex.en: Please turn off the lights when you leave.
ex.zh: 离开时请关灯。

ex.en: He turned off the TV and went to bed.
ex.zh: 他关掉电视上床睡觉。

tip: turn off 与 switch off 同义；反义 turn on。
scene: A hand switching off a lamp in a bedroom.

senses.en: used when people do something to themselves

ex.en: They made the dinner themselves.
ex.zh: 晚餐是他们自己做的。

ex.en: The children enjoyed themselves at the party.
ex.zh: 孩子们在聚会上玩得很开心。

tip: by themselves 表示“独自”；enjoy oneself 是“玩得开心”。
scene: Children laughing and enjoying themselves at a birthday party.

senses.en: near something

ex.en: My house is close to the station.
ex.zh: 我家离车站很近。

ex.en: The children sat close to the fire to get warm.
ex.zh: 孩子们靠近火坐着取暖。

tip: close to 与 near 意思相近；far from 是它的反义表达。
scene: A small house standing right next to a train station building.

senses.en: a large desert animal with one or two humps

ex.en: We rode camels in the desert.
ex.zh: 我们在沙漠里骑了骆驼。

ex.en: The camel has two humps on its back.
ex.zh: 这头骆驼背上有两个驼峰。

tip: 骆驼的驼峰叫 hump；单峰驼是 dromedary。
scene: A camel standing in a sandy desert with dunes in the background.

senses.en: ahead of; before something in position

ex.en: The school is in front of the park.
ex.zh: 学校在公园前面。

ex.en: She stood in front of the class and spoke.
ex.zh: 她站在全班面前发言。

tip: in front of 指“在…前面”；反义词是 behind（在…后面）。
scene: A school building standing in front of a green park with trees.

senses.en: in or to which place

ex.en: Where do you live?
ex.zh: 你住在哪里？

ex.en: Do you know where the library is?
ex.zh: 你知道图书馆在哪里吗？

tip: where 用于询问地点。
scene: A tourist looking at a map and asking where a place is.

senses.en: a machine that plays DVDs

ex.en: The DVD player is under the television.
ex.zh: DVD播放机在电视机下面。

ex.en: Put the film into the DVD player.
ex.zh: 把电影光盘放进DVD播放机里。

tip: DVD player 用来播放 DVD 光盘。
scene: A DVD player on a shelf under a television with a disc sliding in.

senses.en: the time when people work

ex.en: The shop's working hours are nine to six.
ex.zh: 这家店的工作时间是九点到六点。

ex.en: Please call us during working hours.
ex.zh: 请在上班时间给我们打电话。

tip: working hours 是工作时间，即上班时段。
scene: An office clock showing working hours with a schedule on the wall.

senses.en: something that belongs to us

ex.en: This garden is ours.
ex.zh: 这个花园是我们的。

ex.en: Their house is bigger than ours.
ex.zh: 他们的房子比我们的大。

tip: ours 是名词性物主代词，后面不接名词。
scene: Two children playing in their own garden with a swing.

senses.en: a cold drink made with lemons, sugar and water

ex.en: She made fresh lemonade for the picnic.
ex.zh: 她为野餐做了新鲜的柠檬水。

ex.en: Can I have a glass of lemonade, please?
ex.zh: 请给我一杯柠檬水好吗？

col: a glass of lemonade｜一杯柠檬水
tip: lemonade 是柠檬饮料；英式常指气泡柠檬汽水。
scene: A glass jug of lemonade with lemons on a picnic blanket.

senses.en: a person who is shopping

ex.en: The shoppers filled the supermarket on Saturday.
ex.zh: 周六超市里挤满了购物者。

ex.en: Shoppers can park free for two hours.
ex.zh: 购物者可免费停车两小时。

tip: shopper 指正在购物的人；customer 是顾客。
scene: A shopper with carrier bags walking through a busy supermarket.

senses.en: a female person or animal already mentioned

ex.en: She is my sister.
ex.zh: 她是我妹妹。

ex.en: Where is Anna? She is in the kitchen.
ex.zh: 安娜在哪？她在厨房里。

tip: she 是主格；宾格 her，物主代词 hers。
scene: A girl waving from a kitchen doorway as someone asks where she is.

senses.en: food that is made and served quickly

ex.en: We had fast food for lunch because we were in a hurry.
ex.zh: 因为赶时间，我们午饭吃了快餐。

ex.en: Eating too much fast food is not healthy.
ex.zh: 吃太多快餐不健康。

tip: 常见的 fast food 有汉堡、炸鸡、薯条等。
scene: A takeaway counter with burgers and fries in paper wrappers.

senses.en: a polite greeting used in the evening

ex.en: Good evening, ladies and gentlemen.
ex.zh: 女士们先生们，晚上好。

ex.en: We said good evening to the hotel manager.
ex.zh: 我们向酒店经理问晚上好。

tip: good evening 用于傍晚及晚上的问候；晚安说 good night。
scene: A hotel receptionist greeting a guest at the front desk in the evening.

senses.en: the sport of riding a horse

ex.en: She goes riding every Saturday morning.
ex.zh: 她每周六早上去骑马。

ex.en: Riding is a popular sport in the countryside.
ex.zh: 骑马是乡村很受欢迎的运动。

tip: riding 指骑马运动；horse-riding 也是常见说法。
scene: A girl riding a brown horse across a green field.

senses.en: a place where animals are kept for people to see

ex.en: We saw lions and monkeys at the zoo.
ex.zh: 我们在动物园看到了狮子和猴子。

ex.en: The zoo is closed on Mondays.
ex.zh: 动物园周一闭园。

tip: zoo 是动物园；go to the zoo 去动物园。
scene: A zoo entrance with a lion enclosure and children looking in.

senses.en: the people speaking, as objects

ex.en: Our teacher told us an interesting story.
ex.zh: 老师给我们讲了一个有趣的故事。

ex.en: Come with us to the cinema.
ex.zh: 和我们一起去看电影吧。

tip: us 是 we 的宾格，作宾语。
scene: Two friends inviting another to join them walking to a cinema.

senses.en: beyond a place; time before now

ex.en: It's half past two.
ex.zh: 现在两点半。

ex.en: We walked past the library on the way home.
ex.zh: 回家路上我们经过了图书馆。

tip: past 指时间“过了”；half past five 是五点半。
scene: A clock showing half past two on a classroom wall.

senses.en: used to show possession or connection

ex.en: This is a photo of my family.
ex.zh: 这是一张我全家的照片。

ex.en: The door of the shop is open.
ex.zh: 商店的门开着。

tip: of 表示所属关系或数量；a glass of water 一杯水。
scene: A photo frame showing a family picture on a shelf.

senses.zh: 一个（用于元音音素开头的词前）
senses.en: one; used before vowel sounds

ex.en: She ate an apple after lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭后她吃了一个苹果。

ex.en: It takes an hour to get there by bus.
ex.zh: 坐公交车到那里要一个小时。

tip: an 用在元音音素开头的词前，如 an apple、an hour（h 不发音）。
scene: A red apple on a kitchen table next to a lunch plate.

senses.en: the activity of making music with your voice

ex.en: Singing in the choir makes her happy.
ex.zh: 在合唱团唱歌让她很开心。

ex.en: We heard beautiful singing from the music room.
ex.zh: 我们听到音乐教室传来美妙的歌声。

tip: singing 是名词“唱歌”；singer 是歌手。
scene: A girl singing on a small stage with a microphone.

senses.en: belonging to them

ex.en: The children left their bags in the classroom.
ex.zh: 孩子们把书包落在教室里了。

ex.en: Their house is next to the river.
ex.zh: 他们的房子在河边。

tip: their 是形容词性物主代词；theirs 是名词性物主代词。
scene: Two school bags left on hooks in an empty classroom.

senses.en: to do a job, or to function

ex.en: My father works in a hospital.
ex.zh: 我爸爸在医院工作。

ex.en: The lift is not working today.
ex.zh: 电梯今天不能用。

tip: work 作动词“工作/运转”，作名词“工作”；job 是可数名词“工作”。
scene: A nurse working at a hospital desk with a computer.

senses.en: a small plastic card used to pay for things later

ex.en: I paid for the jacket with my credit card.
ex.zh: 我用信用卡买了这件夹克。

ex.en: You can pay by credit card in most shops.
ex.zh: 大多数商店都可以用信用卡付款。

tip: credit card 是信用卡（先消费后还款）；debit card 是借记卡。
scene: A hand holding a credit card near a card machine in a shop.

senses.en: past form of can; used to ask politely

ex.en: Could you help me with this bag?
ex.zh: 你能帮我拿一下这个包吗？

ex.en: When I was five, I could ride a bike.
ex.zh: 我五岁的时候就会骑自行车了。

tip: could 用于请求时比 can 更礼貌，也表示 can 的过去式。
scene: A polite student asking a teacher to help carry a heavy bag.

senses.en: small facts or pieces of information

ex.en: Please send me the details of the trip.
ex.zh: 请把行程的详细信息发给我。

ex.en: She knows all the details about the project.
ex.zh: 她了解这个项目的所有细节。

tip: details 常用复数，指具体信息；personal details 是个人信息。
scene: A form on a desk with personal details filled in by hand.

senses.en: a piece of music with words

ex.en: This song is my favourite at the moment.
ex.zh: 这首歌是我现在最喜欢的。

ex.en: They sang a happy song at the party.
ex.zh: 他们在聚会上唱了一首欢快的歌。

tip: song 是“歌曲”；sing a song 是“唱歌”。
scene: A music note floating over a guitar on a stage.

senses.en: to perform an action or activity

ex.en: What do you do at the weekend?
ex.zh: 你周末做什么？

ex.en: I have a lot of homework to do.
ex.zh: 我有很多作业要做。

tip: do 也用作助动词构成疑问句和否定句：Do you like tea?
scene: A student doing homework at a desk with books and a pencil.

senses.en: to stop sleeping, or to make someone stop sleeping

ex.en: I wake up at six thirty on school days.
ex.zh: 上学日我六点半醒来。

ex.en: Please wake me up at seven tomorrow.
ex.zh: 明天七点请叫醒我。

tip: wake up 是“醒来”；叫醒某人说 wake sb up。
scene: Sunlight coming through curtains as a child wakes up in bed.

senses.en: a machine that washes clothes

ex.en: The washing machine is making a strange noise.
ex.zh: 洗衣机发出奇怪的声音。

ex.en: She put the dirty clothes into the washing machine.
ex.zh: 她把脏衣服放进洗衣机。

tip: washing machine 是洗衣机；do the washing 是洗衣服。
scene: A white washing machine in a laundry room with clothes going in.

senses.en: a person who plays tennis

ex.en: She is a promising young tennis player.
ex.zh: 她是一名有前途的年轻网球运动员。

ex.en: The tennis player served the ball very fast.
ex.zh: 这名网球运动员发球很快。

tip: tennis player 是网球选手；play tennis 是打网球。
scene: A tennis player in white hitting a ball on a court.

senses.en: to enter a bus, train, plane or bike

ex.en: We got on the train just before it left.
ex.zh: 我们正好在火车开走前上了车。

ex.en: She got on her bike and rode away.
ex.zh: 她骑上自行车走了。

col: get on with someone｜和某人相处
tip: get on 表示“上车”；get on with sb 是“与某人相处融洽”。
scene: A child stepping up onto a school bus, holding the handrail.

senses.en: a place filled with water for swimming

ex.en: We go to the swimming pool every Friday.
ex.zh: 我们每周五去游泳池。

ex.en: The hotel has a big outdoor swimming pool.
ex.zh: 这家酒店有一个很大的室外游泳池。

tip: swimming pool 是游泳池；go swimming 是去游泳。
scene: A blue swimming pool with lanes and people swimming.

senses.en: in place of something

ex.en: Let's walk instead of taking the bus.
ex.zh: 我们走路吧，别坐公交车了。

ex.en: She had tea instead of coffee.
ex.zh: 她喝了茶而不是咖啡。

tip: instead of 后接名词/动名词；instead 单独用放在句尾。
scene: Two friends choosing to walk on a path while a bus passes.

senses.en: used to ask permission or say something is possible

ex.en: May I use your pen, please?
ex.zh: 请问我可以用你的钢笔吗？

ex.en: It may rain later, so take an umbrella.
ex.zh: 待会儿可能下雨，带把伞吧。

tip: may 用于请求更正式礼貌；表示可能性时比 might 更可能。
scene: A student politely asking a classmate to borrow a pen.

senses.en: a place where buses stop for passengers

ex.en: Wait for me at the bus stop near the school.
ex.zh: 在学校附近的公交车站等我。

ex.en: The bus stop is just across the road.
ex.zh: 公交车站就在马路对面。

tip: bus stop 是沿途停车点；bus station 是始发/终点总站。
scene: A red bus pulling up at a bus stop with a shelter and a timetable.

senses.en: belonging to an animal or thing

ex.en: The dog wagged its tail happily.
ex.zh: 狗开心地摇着尾巴。

ex.en: The phone is in its case.
ex.zh: 手机在它的保护壳里。

tip: its 是“它的”；注意 it's 是 it is 的缩写，二者易混。
scene: A happy dog wagging its tail in a sunny yard.

senses.en: to join in an activity or event

ex.en: All the students took part in the sports day.
ex.zh: 所有学生都参加了运动会。

ex.en: Would you like to take part in the competition?
ex.zh: 你想参加比赛吗？

tip: take part in 是“参加活动”；join 是“加入组织”。
scene: Students running in a race on a school sports day.

senses.en: no more than; alone in a group

ex.en: I have only one ticket left.
ex.zh: 我只剩一张票了。

ex.en: She is the only girl in the team.
ex.zh: 她是队里唯一的女孩。

tip: only 作副词表示“仅仅”，作形容词表示“唯一的”。
scene: A single ticket lying on an empty table.

senses.en: to put your body in a flat position to rest

ex.en: I need to lie down for a while; I feel tired.
ex.zh: 我需要躺一会儿，我感觉很累。

ex.en: The dog likes to lie down in the shade.
ex.zh: 狗喜欢躺在阴凉处。

tip: lie down 是“躺下”休息；过去式 lay down。
scene: A tired woman lying down on a sofa with a blanket.

senses.en: another informal word for grandmother

ex.en: Granny knitted me a warm scarf.
ex.zh: 奶奶给我织了一条温暖的围巾。

ex.en: We are staying at granny's house for the holiday.
ex.zh: 假期我们住在奶奶家。

tip: granny 与 grandma 都是对奶奶/外婆的亲昵称呼。
scene: A grandmother knitting a scarf in a rocking chair by the window.

senses.en: many different types of something

ex.en: The toy shop has all sorts of board games.
ex.zh: 这家玩具店有各种各样的桌游。

ex.en: She likes reading all sorts of books.
ex.zh: 她喜欢读各种各样的书。

tip: all sorts of 和 all kinds of 意思相近，都可以表示“各种各样的”。
scene: A colourful toy shop shelf filled with many different types of games.

senses.en: a signal with red, yellow and green lights for traffic

ex.en: Stop at the traffic light and wait for green.
ex.zh: 在红绿灯前停下，等绿灯。

ex.en: The traffic light turned red just as we arrived.
ex.zh: 我们到的时候红绿灯刚变红。

tip: traffic light 红绿灯；green light 绿灯通行，red light 红灯停。
scene: A traffic light showing green above a busy crossing.

senses.en: before anything else

ex.en: First of all, let me thank everyone for coming.
ex.zh: 首先，感谢大家的到来。

ex.en: First of all, wash your hands.
ex.zh: 首先，洗一下手。

tip: first of all 用于列举时的第一点，类似 firstly。
scene: A teacher raising one finger to say first of all to a class.

senses.en: a polite way to show thanks

ex.en: Thank you for the lovely birthday card.
ex.zh: 谢谢你送的美好生日贺卡。

ex.en: 'Thank you very much,' she said with a smile.
ex.zh: “非常感谢。”她笑着说。

tip: thank you very much 是“非常感谢”；口语常说 thanks。
scene: A girl smiling and saying thank you as she receives a card.

senses.zh: 完全；根本（用于否定句、疑问句）
senses.en: in any way; used in negatives and questions

ex.en: I don't like this film at all.
ex.zh: 我一点也不喜欢这部电影。

ex.en: Are you tired at all?
ex.zh: 你有一点累吗？

tip: at all 用于否定句表示“一点也不”，用于疑问句表示“究竟、到底”。
scene: A girl frowning and shaking her head while watching a film on TV.

senses.en: a person who works in business

ex.en: She is a business person who travels a lot.
ex.zh: 她是一位经常出差的商务人士。

ex.en: The hotel welcomes business people from all over the world.
ex.zh: 这家酒店欢迎来自世界各地的商务人士。

tip: business person 是不分性别的说法，比 businessman/businesswoman 更中性。
scene: A person in a suit with a briefcase walking into a glass office building.

senses.en: a child who goes to school

ex.en: Every schoolchild in the town got a free book.
ex.zh: 镇上的每个学童都得到了一本免费的书。

ex.en: The schoolchildren walked to the museum in a line.
ex.zh: 小学生们排着队走去博物馆。

tip: schoolchild 复数 schoolchildren；pupil 也指学生。
scene: Schoolchildren in uniform walking in a line with backpacks.

senses.en: used to make a word or sentence negative

ex.en: I am not hungry right now.
ex.zh: 我现在不饿。

ex.en: This is not my umbrella.
ex.zh: 这不是我的伞。

tip: not 用于构成否定；can not 可缩为 can't，is not 缩为 isn't。
scene: A girl shaking her head at a plate of food, saying she's not hungry.

senses.en: as a result of something

ex.en: The match was cancelled because of the rain.
ex.zh: 比赛因为下雨被取消了。

ex.en: She stayed at home because of her cold.
ex.zh: 她因为感冒待在家里。

tip: because of 后接名词/代词；because 后接完整句子。
scene: A wet football pitch with raindrops falling, a match sign saying cancelled.

senses.en: to get dressed or put something on your body

ex.en: Put on your coat, it's cold outside.
ex.zh: 穿上外套，外面很冷。

ex.en: She put on her glasses to read.
ex.zh: 她戴上眼镜看书。

tip: put on 是“穿上/戴上”；反义短语是 take off（脱下）。
scene: A child putting on a warm coat by the front door.

senses.en: a sweatshirt with a hood

ex.en: He wears a grey hoodie every day.
ex.zh: 他每天都穿一件灰色连帽衫。

ex.en: My new hoodie has a pocket in the front.
ex.zh: 我的新连帽衫前面有个口袋。

tip: hoodie 是带帽子的运动衫，学生中很流行。
scene: A grey hoodie hanging on a hanger in a teenager's bedroom.

senses.en: to lift something up, or to collect someone

ex.en: Please pick up the litter and put it in the bin.
ex.zh: 请捡起垃圾放进垃圾桶。

ex.en: Mum will pick me up after school.
ex.zh: 妈妈放学后来接我。

tip: pick up 有多种意思：捡起、接人、学会（pick up a language）。
scene: A child picking up a piece of paper and putting it in a bin.

senses.en: the business of running a bank

ex.en: He works in banking in the city centre.
ex.zh: 他在市中心从事银行业。

ex.en: Online banking makes it easy to pay bills.
ex.zh: 网上银行让支付账单变得简单。

tip: banking 是银行业；online banking 是网上银行。
scene: A person using online banking on a laptop at home.

senses.en: to delay something to a later time

ex.en: They put off the meeting until Friday.
ex.zh: 他们把会议推迟到周五。

ex.en: Don't put off your homework till the last minute.
ex.zh: 别把作业拖到最后一刻。

tip: put off 表示“推迟”；put off doing 是“拖延做某事”。
scene: A calendar with a meeting crossed out and moved to Friday.

senses.en: a container for recycling glass bottles

ex.en: We take our old bottles to the bottle bank.
ex.zh: 我们把旧瓶子送到回收箱。

ex.en: The bottle bank is full; we'll come back later.
ex.zh: 回收箱满了，我们晚点再来。

tip: bottle bank 是街边的玻璃瓶回收点。
