scene: Colourful glass bottles being dropped into a bottle recycling bin.

senses.en: especially; more than usual

ex.en: I particularly enjoyed the music at the concert.
ex.zh: 我特别喜欢音乐会上的音乐。

ex.en: It was particularly cold this winter.
ex.zh: 今年冬天特别冷。

tip: particularly 表示“尤其、特别地”。
scene: A person smiling at a concert, enjoying the music especially.

senses.en: the player who guards the goal

ex.en: The goalkeeper saved two important shots.
ex.zh: 守门员扑救了两次关键射门。

ex.en: He is the best goalkeeper in our school team.
ex.zh: 他是我们校队最好的守门员。

tip: goalkeeper 是守门员，口语常简称 keeper。
scene: A goalkeeper in gloves diving to save a ball in a goal.

senses.en: without sleeves

ex.en: She wore a sleeveless dress in summer.
ex.zh: 夏天她穿无袖连衣裙。

ex.en: The sleeveless shirt is cool and light.
ex.zh: 这件无袖衬衫凉爽轻便。

tip: sleeveless 是“无袖的”；-less 表示“没有”。
scene: A sleeveless summer dress hanging on a hanger.

senses.en: a long narrow line of colour

ex.en: The T-shirt has blue and white stripes.
ex.zh: 这件T恤有蓝白条纹。

ex.en: A zebra has black and white stripes.
ex.zh: 斑马有黑白条纹。

tip: stripe 是条纹；striped 是“有条纹的”。
scene: A blue and white striped T-shirt on a hanger.

senses.en: as many as; until; depending on

ex.en: The bus can carry up to fifty passengers.
ex.zh: 这辆公交车最多可载五十名乘客。

ex.en: It's up to you to decide.
ex.zh: 由你决定。

tip: up to 表示“多达/直到”；be up to sb 是“由某人决定”。
scene: A full bus with a sign showing passenger capacity.

senses.en: the hours when a shop or office is open

ex.en: The museum's opening hours are ten to five.
ex.zh: 博物馆的营业时间是十点到五点。

ex.en: Check the opening hours before you visit.
ex.zh: 参观前请查看营业时间。

tip: opening hours 是营业/开放时间。
scene: A sign on a shop door showing the opening hours.

senses.en: on fire; very hot

ex.en: The burning building sent smoke into the sky.
ex.zh: 燃烧的大楼冒出浓烟。

ex.en: She had a burning fever and stayed in bed.
ex.zh: 她发高烧，卧床休息。

tip: burning 是形容词“燃烧的、滚烫的”。
scene: A small fire burning in a garden fire pit with logs.

senses.en: to use all of something and have none left

ex.en: We ran out of milk, so I went to the shop.
ex.zh: 牛奶喝完了，所以我去商店。

ex.en: Time is running out for the exam.
ex.zh: 考试时间快用完了。

tip: run out of + 名词 表示“用完某物”。
scene: An empty milk carton in a fridge.

senses.en: to look for something carefully

ex.en: I searched online for a cheap hotel.
ex.zh: 我在网上搜索便宜的酒店。

ex.en: The search for the missing cat continued all day.
ex.zh: 寻找失踪猫咪的行动持续了一整天。

tip: search for 是“搜索寻找”；search engine 是搜索引擎。
scene: A person typing a search query into a laptop.

senses.en: used to talk about the future

ex.en: I will call you tomorrow.
ex.zh: 我明天会给你打电话。

ex.en: Will you come to my party on Saturday?
ex.zh: 你周六会来参加我的聚会吗？

tip: will + 动词原形表示将来；口语缩写 'll。
scene: A person talking on the phone, promising to call tomorrow.

senses.en: the dot at the end of a sentence (British English)

ex.en: Write a full stop at the end of each sentence.
ex.zh: 每个句子结尾要写句号。

ex.en: In the US, a full stop is called a period.
ex.zh: 在美国，句号叫 period。

tip: full stop 是英式说法；美式说 period。
scene: A sentence on a blackboard ending with a red full stop.

senses.en: a place where you buy tickets

ex.en: We bought our train tickets at the booking office.
ex.zh: 我们在售票处买了火车票。

ex.en: The booking office opens at nine in the morning.
ex.zh: 售票处早上九点开门。

tip: booking office 即售票处，常见于火车站、剧院。
scene: A train station booking office window with tickets being handed over.

senses.zh: 旅行社职员；旅行代理人
senses.en: a person who helps you book holidays

ex.en: The travel agent booked our flights and hotel.
ex.zh: 旅行社职员帮我们订了机票和酒店。

ex.en: Ask the travel agent about cheap packages.
ex.zh: 问问旅行社职员有哪些便宜套餐。

tip: travel agent 是旅行代理；travel agency 是旅行社。
scene: A travel agent showing holiday brochures to a customer.

senses.en: to choose or try something

ex.en: I'll go for the salad, please.
ex.zh: 我要沙拉。

ex.en: She decided to go for the job interview.
ex.zh: 她决定去参加求职面试。

tip: go for 表示“选择、尝试”，也表“去拿”。
scene: A person choosing a salad at a food counter.

senses.en: Involving people physically present together and looking at each other.
With people physically present together rather than communicating remotely.

ex.en: We arranged a face-to-face meeting at the local café.
ex.zh: 我们安排在附近的咖啡馆当面会谈。

ex.en: Face-to-face communication can strengthen relationships between teachers and students by allowing immediate feedback and clearer emotional expression.
ex.zh: 面对面交流能提供即时反馈并更清晰地表达情感，从而增进师生关系。

tip: 名词前通常加连字符；作状语时常写face to face。

senses.en: if; used to express a choice

ex.en: I don't know whether she will come.
ex.zh: 我不知道她是否会来。

ex.en: Ask whether the shop is open on Sundays.
ex.zh: 问问商店周日是否开门。

tip: whether 与 if 都可表“是否”；whether 后可直接接 or not。
scene: A person on the phone asking whether a shop is open.

senses.en: probable; expected to happen

ex.en: It is likely to rain this afternoon.
ex.zh: 今天下午很可能下雨。

ex.en: She is likely to win the race.
ex.zh: 她很可能会赢得比赛。

tip: be likely to do 表示“很可能…”；反义 unlikely。
scene: Dark clouds over a park, people holding umbrellas.

senses.en: a computer that stores data, or a waiter

ex.en: The website is on a server in another country.
ex.zh: 这个网站在另一个国家的服务器上。

ex.en: The server brought our drinks quickly.
ex.zh: 服务员很快送来了我们的饮料。

tip: server 指电脑“服务器”，美式也指餐厅“服务员”。
scene: A row of server machines with blinking lights in a data room.

senses.en: to find information, or to raise your eyes

ex.en: Look up the word in the dictionary.
ex.zh: 在词典里查这个词。

ex.en: Things are looking up for our team.
ex.zh: 我们队的情况正在好转。

tip: look up 表示“查阅（资料）”；look up to 是“尊敬”。
scene: A student looking up a word in a dictionary at a desk.

senses.en: used in speech to check understanding

ex.en: You know, the new café near the station.
ex.zh: 你知道的，车站附近那家新咖啡馆。

ex.en: It's a really nice place, you know.
ex.zh: 那是个很棒的地方，你懂的。

tip: you know 是口语填充语，用于引出对方已知的信息。
scene: Two friends chatting at a table, one gesturing with a hand.

senses.en: the bright flash of light in a storm

ex.en: Lightning lit up the sky during the storm.
ex.zh: 暴风雨中闪电照亮了天空。

ex.en: We saw lightning in the distance.
ex.zh: 我们看到了远处的闪电。

tip: lightning 是闪电；thunder 是雷声。
scene: A bright lightning bolt striking across a dark stormy sky.

senses.en: to hit someone to the ground, or to destroy a building

ex.en: The strong wind knocked down the old fence.
ex.zh: 大风把旧篱笆刮倒了。

ex.en: They plan to knock down the old building.
ex.zh: 他们计划拆除旧楼。

tip: knock down 表示“撞倒/拆除”。
scene: A digger knocking down an old brick wall.

senses.en: immediately, right now

ex.en: Come here at once! It's important.
ex.zh: 马上过来！有重要的事。

ex.en: She answered the phone at once.
ex.zh: 她立刻接了电话。

tip: at once 是“立刻、马上”的意思。
scene: A parent calling a child to come at once from the doorway.

senses.en: to use something as the starting point

ex.en: The film is based on a true story.
ex.zh: 这部电影根据真实故事改编。

ex.en: You should base your answer on the facts.
ex.zh: 你的回答应该以事实为依据。

tip: be based on 是“基于、以…为依据”，被动形式很常用。
scene: A film poster next to a book, showing the film is based on the book.

senses.en: a small camera used with a computer

ex.en: She turns off her webcam during online classes.
ex.zh: 上网课时她会关闭摄像头。

ex.en: The webcam has a built-in microphone.
ex.zh: 这个摄像头内置麦克风。

tip: webcam 是电脑摄像头，用于视频通话。
scene: A small webcam sitting on top of a laptop screen.

senses.en: to end a relationship, or to break into pieces

ex.en: They broke up after three years together.
ex.zh: 他们在一起三年后分手了。

ex.en: The ice on the lake broke up in spring.
ex.zh: 春天湖面的冰裂开了。

tip: break up 常见义为“分手”；也指“解散、破碎”。
scene: Two people walking away in different directions on a street.

senses.en: the value of one currency in another

ex.en: The exchange rate between the two currencies changed today.
ex.zh: 今天这两种货币的汇率变了。

ex.en: You can check the exchange rate online.
ex.zh: 你可以在网上查汇率。

tip: exchange rate 是汇率；currency exchange 是货币兑换。
scene: A currency exchange board showing different exchange rates.

senses.en: to build, hang or raise something

ex.en: They put up a tent in the garden.
ex.zh: 他们在花园里搭了一顶帐篷。

ex.en: Please put up your hand if you know the answer.
ex.zh: 知道答案请举手。

tip: put up 有“搭起、张贴、举起”等义。
scene: Two people putting up a tent in a garden.

senses.en: to stop trying or stop doing something

ex.en: Don't give up; you are doing well!
ex.zh: 别放弃，你做得很好！

ex.en: He gave up smoking last year.
ex.zh: 他去年戒烟了。

tip: give up 表示“放弃”或“戒除（习惯）”。
scene: A coach encouraging a tired runner not to give up.

senses.en: to remove something unwanted

ex.en: We need to get rid of this old sofa.
ex.zh: 我们需要扔掉这张旧沙发。

ex.en: He got rid of his bad habit of staying up late.
ex.zh: 他改掉了熬夜的坏习惯。

tip: get rid of 是“摆脱/处理掉”。
scene: Two people carrying an old sofa out of a house.

senses.en: to relax completely

ex.en: We chilled out by the pool all afternoon.
ex.zh: 我们整个下午都在泳池边放松。

ex.en: Chill out! Everything will be fine.
ex.zh: 冷静点！一切都会好的。

tip: chill out 是口语“放松、冷静”。
scene: A person relaxing in a pool chair with sunglasses and a drink.

senses.en: a person who protects a building or people

ex.en: The security guard checked our bags at the entrance.
ex.zh: 保安在入口检查了我们的包。

ex.en: A security guard watches the building at night.
ex.zh: 保安夜里看守大楼。

tip: security guard 是保安/警卫人员。
scene: A security guard in uniform checking bags at a building entrance.

senses.en: making you feel sad because it is not as good as hoped

ex.en: The film was disappointing; the ending was weak.
ex.zh: 这部电影令人失望，结尾很弱。

ex.en: It was disappointing that it rained on our picnic.
ex.zh: 野餐时下雨真让人失望。

tip: disappointing 形容事物；disappointed 形容人的感受。
scene: A person walking out of a cinema shaking their head.

senses.en: mathematics (American English)

ex.en: Math is my favourite subject at school.
ex.zh: 数学是我在学校最喜欢的科目。

ex.en: She is good at math and science.
ex.zh: 她擅长数学和科学。

tip: math 是美式说法；英式说 maths。
scene: A blackboard with maths equations written on it.

senses.en: on or towards the right side

ex.en: The shops are on the right-hand side of the street.
ex.zh: 商店在街道右侧。

ex.en: She is my right-hand helper in the office.
ex.zh: 她是我在办公室的得力助手。

tip: right-hand 是“右侧的”；right-hand side 右侧。
scene: A street with shops lined up on the right-hand side.

senses.en: the part of a country's military that uses planes

ex.en: His uncle is a pilot in the air force.
ex.zh: 他叔叔是空军飞行员。

ex.en: The air force held an air show at the airport.
ex.zh: 空军在机场举行了飞行表演。

tip: air force 是空军；navy 海军，army 陆军。
scene: Military jets flying in formation over an airfield.

senses.en: a person who plays the guitar

ex.en: The guitarist played a beautiful solo.
ex.zh: 吉他手演奏了一段优美的独奏。

ex.en: She is a guitarist in a rock band.
ex.zh: 她是一支摇滚乐队的吉他手。

tip: guitarist 是吉他手；pianist 钢琴手。
scene: A guitarist playing an acoustic guitar on a small stage.

senses.en: a person who supports a team or an idea

ex.en: The football supporters cheered loudly.
ex.zh: 足球迷们大声欢呼。

ex.en: She is a strong supporter of the environment.
ex.zh: 她是环保的坚定支持者。

tip: supporter 是“支持者”；体育场景中指球迷。
scene: Football supporters cheering with scarves in a stadium.

senses.en: to visit briefly, or to phone in

ex.en: She called in to see us on her way home.
ex.zh: 她回家路上顺便来看我们。

ex.en: Listeners can call in to the radio show.
ex.zh: 听众可以打电话进广播节目。

tip: call in 表示“顺便来访”或“打电话进来”。
scene: A friend popping by the front door with a small gift.

senses.en: a person who shares a room or flat with you

ex.en: My roommate is from Italy.
ex.zh: 我的室友来自意大利。

ex.en: She gets on well with her roommate.
ex.zh: 她和室友相处得很好。

tip: roommate 是室友；英式分房间共享说 flatmate/housemate。
scene: Two roommates chatting in a shared bedroom.

senses.en: wide; including many things

ex.en: They crossed a broad river by boat.
ex.zh: 他们乘船渡过一条宽阔的河。

ex.en: The course covers a broad range of topics.
ex.zh: 这门课程涵盖广泛的主题。

tip: broad 与 wide 都指“宽”；broad 也引申为“广泛的”。
scene: A wide river with a boat crossing under a bridge.

senses.en: not important

ex.en: The colour of the box is unimportant.
ex.zh: 盒子的颜色不重要。

ex.en: Don't worry about unimportant details.
ex.zh: 别为无关紧要的细节担心。

tip: unimportant 是 important 的反义词“不重要的”。
scene: A person ignoring small unimportant papers on a desk.

senses.en: to become something different

ex.en: The old factory turned into a museum.
ex.zh: 旧工厂变成了博物馆。

ex.en: Water turns into ice when it freezes.
ex.zh: 水结冰时变成冰。

tip: turn into 表示“变成”；turn A into B 把A变成B。
scene: An old factory building converted into a museum with visitors.

senses.en: actually; used to give more information

ex.en: I thought he was a teacher; in fact, he's a doctor.
ex.zh: 我以为他是老师，事实上他是医生。

ex.en: In fact, the city is quite small.
ex.zh: 事实上，这座城市很小。

tip: in fact 用来纠正或补充事实。
scene: Two people talking, one correcting the other with a fact.

senses.en: a dangerous and exciting sport

ex.en: Skydiving is an extreme sport.
ex.zh: 跳伞是一项极限运动。

ex.en: He loves extreme sports like rock climbing.
ex.zh: 他喜欢攀岩之类的极限运动。

tip: extreme sport 是极限运动，如跳伞、攀岩、冲浪等。
scene: A rock climber scaling a steep cliff face.

senses.en: always telling other people what to do

ex.en: Her older sister is a bit bossy.
ex.zh: 她姐姐有点爱发号施令。

ex.en: Don't be so bossy; let everyone decide.
ex.zh: 别这么专横，让大家自己决定。

tip: bossy 是形容词，形容喜欢指挥别人的人。
scene: A girl pointing and giving orders to friends in a playground.

senses.en: a medicine that stops pain and fever

ex.en: She took an aspirin for her headache.
ex.zh: 她吃了片阿司匹林治头痛。

ex.en: Aspirin can help with a fever.
ex.zh: 阿司匹林有助于退烧。

col: take an aspirin｜吃一片阿司匹林
tip: take an aspirin 吃阿司匹林；服药说 take medicine。
scene: A hand taking a white medicine tablet out of a small packet.

senses.zh: 穿着衣服的；穿戴整齐的
senses.en: wearing clothes

ex.en: Get dressed quickly, we are late!
ex.zh: 快点穿好衣服，我们要迟到了！

ex.en: She was dressed in a blue coat.
ex.zh: 她穿着一件蓝色外套。

tip: get dressed 表示“穿好衣服”这个动作；be dressed in 表示“穿着”。
scene: A child pulling on a jumper in a bright bedroom in the morning.

senses.en: the person or people spoken to

ex.en: You are my best friend.
ex.zh: 你是我最好的朋友。

ex.en: Are you coming to the party?
ex.zh: 你来参加聚会吗？

tip: you 单复数同形；you 的形容词性物主代词是 your。
scene: Two friends talking face to face on a sunny path.

senses.en: the hand on the right side of your body

ex.en: She writes with her right hand.
ex.zh: 她用右手写字。

ex.en: Hold the cup in your right hand.
ex.zh: 用右手拿着杯子。

tip: right hand 是右手；反义 left hand 左手。
scene: A child raising their right hand in class.

senses.en: title used before a man's surname

ex.en: Mr Brown is our new English teacher.
ex.zh: 布朗先生是我们新的英语老师。

ex.en: Good morning, Mr Smith.
ex.zh: 早上好，史密斯先生。

tip: Mr 用于男性姓氏前；Mrs 用于已婚女性，Ms 用于女性（不限婚否）。
scene: A friendly male teacher standing at a classroom door with books.

senses.en: a small animal with a shell that moves very slowly

ex.en: The snail crawled slowly across the path.
ex.zh: 蜗牛慢慢地爬过小路。

ex.en: We found a snail in the garden after the rain.
ex.zh: 雨后我们在花园里发现了一只蜗牛。

tip: snail 蜗牛以“慢”著称；slippery as a snail 之类的习语少见，记住词义即可。
scene: A snail with its shell crawling across a green leaf.

senses.en: relating to the Olympic Games

ex.en: She watched the Olympic Games on TV.
ex.zh: 她在电视上观看奥运会。

ex.en: The Olympic torch arrived in the city.
ex.zh: 奥运圣火到达了这座城市。

tip: the Olympic Games 是“奥运会”，也常说 the Olympics。
scene: An Olympic torch with five colourful rings symbol on a stadium.

senses.en: a large building with many shops

ex.en: We spent the afternoon at the shopping centre.
ex.zh: 我们在购物中心待了一下午。

ex.en: The new shopping centre has a cinema inside.
ex.zh: 新购物中心里面有一家电影院。

tip: shopping centre 是英式说法；美式常说 shopping mall。
scene: A modern shopping centre with glass walls and people carrying bags.

senses.en: something that belongs to you

ex.en: This seat is yours.
ex.zh: 这个座位是你的。

ex.en: My umbrella is red; yours is black.
ex.zh: 我的伞是红色的，你的是黑色的。

tip: yours 是名词性物主代词；yours sincerely 是信件结尾敬语。
scene: A red umbrella and a black umbrella standing side by side by a door.

senses.en: a place on the internet where people chat

ex.en: They met in an online chatroom.
ex.zh: 他们在一个在线聊天室里认识。

ex.en: Be careful what you share in a chatroom.
ex.zh: 在聊天室里注意不要随意分享信息。

tip: 在 chatroom 里要注意安全，不透露个人信息。
scene: A laptop screen showing a friendly chat window with speech bubbles.

senses.en: used when two people do the same thing to one another

ex.en: The twins help each other with homework.
ex.zh: 这对双胞胎互相帮助做作业。

ex.en: They looked at each other and smiled.
ex.zh: 他们相视而笑。

tip: each other 表示两者或多者“互相”；常用于 help/look at 等动词后。
scene: Two twins sitting at a desk helping each other with homework.

senses.en: a person who works in a shop helping customers

ex.en: The shop assistant helped me find the right size.
ex.zh: 店员帮我找到了合适的尺码。

ex.en: Ask the shop assistant how much this costs.
ex.zh: 问问店员这个多少钱。

tip: shop assistant 是英式说法，指商店里的服务员。
scene: A shop assistant in a uniform helping a customer at a counter.

senses.en: to exist; used with names, ages, feelings

ex.en: I am twelve years old.
ex.zh: 我十二岁。

ex.en: They are my best friends.
ex.zh: 他们是我最好的朋友。

tip: be 的现在时形式是 am/is/are，过去时是 was/were。
scene: A classroom blackboard showing the words am, is, are with happy faces.

senses.en: the people or things already mentioned, as objects

ex.en: I called them yesterday evening.
ex.zh: 我昨晚给他们打了电话。

ex.en: Please give the books to them.
ex.zh: 请把书给他们。

tip: them 是 they 的宾格，作宾语用。
scene: A person handing a stack of books to two children.

senses.zh: 迪斯科舞会；迪斯科音乐
senses.en: a place or party where people dance to pop music

ex.en: There is a school disco on Friday night.
ex.zh: 周五晚上有一场学校舞会。

ex.en: They danced at the disco until ten o'clock.
ex.zh: 他们在舞会上跳到十点。

tip: disco 指跳流行音乐的舞会/舞厅；go to a disco 去跳舞。
scene: A colourful school hall with flashing lights and teenagers dancing.

senses.en: a game played on a screen or computer

ex.en: He plays video games for an hour after school.
ex.zh: 他放学后玩一小时电子游戏。

ex.en: This video game is popular with children.
ex.zh: 这款电子游戏很受孩子们欢迎。

tip: video game 是电子/视频游戏；play a video game 玩游戏。
scene: A child playing a video game with a controller in a living room.
